title: Luxury Presales
description:
**Position:** 
 Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Presales
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and customer\-focused Presales professional with experience in the luxury real estate segment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing customer inquiries, qualifying leads, delivering exceptional customer experiences, coordinating site visits, and supporting the sales team in achieving business targets. The candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a consultative sales approach, and the ability to engage with high\-net\-worth individuals (HNIs).
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Handle inbound and outbound customer inquiries through calls, emails, WhatsApp, digital platforms, and walk\-ins.
* Qualify prospective buyers based on budget, requirements, and purchase intent.
* Provide detailed information about luxury residential projects, amenities, floor plans, pricing, and payment plans.
* Schedule and coordinate site visits while ensuring a premium customer experience.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospective customers throughout the sales funnel.
* Maintain accurate customer records and update all interactions in CRM systems.
* Follow up with leads regularly to maximize conversion opportunities.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, CRM, and Channel Partner teams for seamless lead management.
* Track lead status, conversion ratios, and sales pipeline performance.
* Ensure timely response to all customer queries while maintaining high service standards.
* Support project launches, promotional campaigns, events, and exhibitions.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on lead generation and conversion.
* Stay updated on market trends, competitor projects, and customer preferences within the luxury housing segment.



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Customer\-centric approach with consultative selling capabilities.
* Experience handling HNI/UHNI customers.
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced sales environment.
* High level of professionalism and grooming suitable for luxury clientele.



**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or any relevant discipline.
* MBA (Marketing/Sales) is preferred.



**Preferred Experience** 



* 4–8 years of experience in Presales within the real estate industry.
* Mandatory experience in luxury or premium residential projects.
* Exposure to handling digital leads from platforms such as Google, Meta, Magicbricks, Housing.com, 99acres, and company websites.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, LeadSquared, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of luxury homebuyer expectations and customer engagement strategies.

title: Senior Presales Engineer
description:
The Role
 



  





 We are seeking a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer to serve as the technical backbone of our enterprise sales efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives to drive complex, high\-value AI opportunities from qualification through to close – translating capabilities into compelling, customer\-specific solutions. This is a highly visible role that demands both deep technical expertise and the ability to communicate confidently at every level, from hands\-on IT architects to C\-suite executives.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  




* Act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, partnering with Account Executives to drive enterprise opportunities from qualification to close.
* Develop and maintain a strong perspective on how AI – including large language models, agentic architectures, and RAG\-based solutions – can drive measurable business value across verticals and functions.
* Understand customer pain points in adopting and implementing AI solutions, and position as the trusted partner to address them.
* Deliver compelling technical presentations and demos showcasing GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, and LLM\-based capabilities tailored to each prospect’s context.
* Build and deliver custom demos and proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) to validate business value and technical feasibility.
* Conduct discovery sessions with key business and technical stakeholders to uncover needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.
* Translate business requirements into AI solution architectures that leverage Uniphore’s capabilities, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams.
* Respond to RFPs and RFIs with detailed technical responses and well\-reasoned solution designs.
* Advise clients on AI adoption strategies, integration with multi\-modal data platforms, and industry best practices.
* Share market intelligence and competitive insights with the wider team to sharpen our regional go\-to\-market approach.
* Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous innovation.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in AI trends, competitor offerings, and the evolving landscape of agentic and enterprise AI adoption.



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of experience in pre\-sales, solution engineering, or technical consulting – preferably within enterprise SaaS, AI, or automation platforms.
* Hands\-on understanding of AI concepts including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, Agentic AI architectures, AI security and governance, and ethical AI.
* Experience designing or selling AI platforms, data orchestration, or enterprise automation solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including core services such as compute, storage, networking, and serverless functions, particularly as they relate to deploying and scaling enterprise AI and SaaS solutions.
* Practical experience with API integration and security: designing, integrating, and securing API connections between AI platforms and business applications (e.g., CRM, ERP, data warehouses), with knowledge of protocols (REST, GraphQL) and authentication mechanisms (OAuth 2\.0, API keys).
* Data and network architecture acumen – ability to discuss and propose solutions around data governance, network segmentation, and enterprise security when deploying cloud\-native or hybrid AI solutions.
* Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, from technicians to C\-suite executives.
* Proven track record supporting enterprise sales cycles and contributing to the close of large, multi\-stakeholder deals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with confidence at all levels of a large enterprise.
* Strong problem\-solving and storytelling skills – able to connect AI capabilities to strategic business outcomes.
* Familiarity with one or more of priority sectors – banking and financial services, media and telecom, retail and CPG, government, or energy and utilities – is a strong advantage.
* Ability to travel as needed for client engagements.

title: RIS Solution Advisory - Senior Manager - Products - Industrials
description:

 A seasoned consulting professional with deep Industrial Equipment Sector expertise. You will join a multi\-disciplinary team that supports pre\-sales solutioning, crafts proposals and provides strategic guidance to win transformative client projects globally.
   

  

 Key Focus Areas:
   

  

 Product \& Service Innovation: industrial servitization and PaaS models; service\-based B2C/B2B models for industrial and heavy equipment clients; connected products, recurring revenue and customer\-centric value propositions.
   

  

 Digital Transformation \& Smart Manufacturing: Industry 4\.0, IIoT, digital twins; factory automation, robotics, advanced analytics; sustainable manufacturing and circular economy.

 Sector Expertise: strong grasp of Industrial Equipment value chains, operating models and business challenges, and of the global Industrials landscape and its regulatory drivers.

 A collaborative environment where your leadership drives innovation

title: Senior TME - Private 5G
description:

 **Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G)** 
 and
 **Enterprise 5G Coverage/Neutral Host Solutions** 
 powered by the Ericsson Radio Dot System.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Technical Marketing Engineer (TME)** 
 to join our Bangalore team and drive the technical positioning, validation, and go\-to\-market enablement of Ericsson's
 **Private 5G and Enterprise Neutral Host portfolio** 
 .
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a key technical bridge between Product Management, R\&D, sales teams, partners, mobile operators, and enterprise customers. You will develop reference architectures, validate deployments, create technical content, and demonstrate the value of Ericsson's enterprise cellular solutions for industrial and large\-venue environments.

title: Solutions Architect, IT Services
description:
**Description**
* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
   

  

 Delhi
   

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.


 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

 Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww
   

  

**About The Team**
 Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C\#, or C\+\+
* Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 As part of Supply Chain \& Engineering (Direct Spend Optimization), you will help clients improve EBITDA and build more resilient supply chains by transforming Direct Materials, the supplier facing materials, components and externally manufactured inputs that flow directly into products.
   

  

 The role combines deep direct category expertise with engineering led cost transformation, strategic sourcing, supplier ecosystem design, digital/ AI enablement, and disciplined value realization. You will work across the full Direct Materials agenda what to buy, where to buy, who to buy from, for how much, how and when to buy, and how to sustain value.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
* Direct Materials diagnostics and value assessments: Establish spend/category baselines, identify cost drivers and size opportunities using spend, BOM, supplier, specification, and operational data.
* Should\-costing, teardowns \& Design\-to\-Value: Build bottom\-up should cost models using BOMs, drawings/ CAD, material and process inputs; conduct product/component teardowns and competitive benchmarking; identify value through VA/VE, specification optimization, part/ SKU standardization, make vs buy and complexity reduction.
* Strategic sourcing and commercial excellence: Develop category strategies, run competitive sourcing, fact\-based negotiations, contract optimization, commodity intelligence, price risk/hedging and total cost of ownership interventions; incorporate sustainability into overall strategies.
* Supplier ecosystem and resilience: Support best country sourcing, localization, alternate supplier discovery, supplier consolidation, dual/multi\-sourcing, supply network optimization, and risk mitigation.
* AI/ Agentic Direct Procurement: Shape and deploy practical AI/ GenAI/ Agentic use cases across spend analytics, should cost modelling, supplier discovery, commodity and market intelligence, guided negotiation, complexity reduction, tariff intelligence, and Source to Pay workflows.
* Value realization and sustainment: Translate opportunities into business cases, execution roadmaps, contracted savings, supplier performance mechanisms, operating\-model improvements, and managed\-service/ continuous\-improvement models.


**Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role**
* Strong analytical problem solving with the ability to connect commercial, engineering, supply chain and financial data.
* Ability to work across Procurement, Engineering/ R\&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance and Technology stakeholders.
* Strong client leadership, communication, executive presentation, and team management skills.
* Comfort with digital, analytics and emerging AI technologies, with a practical focus on measurable business outcomes.


**Role Details**
**Drive client value creation**
* Understand the client business, product economics, direct material cost base, leadership priorities and value agenda.
* Co\-create transformation strategies spanning cost, margin, resilience, productivity and AI\-enabled procurement.
* Build credibility with C\-suite and functional leaders through deep industry/category understanding and fact\-based insights.


**Lead program delivery**
* Lead Direct Materials engagements from rapid diagnostic and value assessment through sourcing, negotiation, implementation and sustained value realization.
* Guide teams across spend/ BOM analytics, should\-costing, teardown/value engineering, commodity and market intelligence, sourcing strategy, supplier assessment, risk analysis, business cases and roadmaps.
* Ensure value is translated into executable actions, finance aligned benefits and scalable client capabilities.


**Grow The Business And Our Capabilities**
* Support/originate Direct Materials opportunities, shape client propositions and develop differentiated commercial pathways.
* Bring together category, engineering, industry, data/ AI and technology capabilities to solve client problems end to end.
* Develop reusable assets, playbooks and points of view across Direct Materials transformation and Agentic AI.

title: Presales Engineer
description:
**About Covlant** 

  






 Covlant is building the AI\-native quality layer for modern software teams. Most engineering organizations face the same trade\-off on every release: run the entire regression suite and wait hours for feedback, or run a subset and risk letting defects slip into production. Covlant removes that trade\-off.
 




  






 Our AI\-driven impact testing platform analyzes every pull request against a deep map of the entire codebase to understand exactly what changed and what that change affects. It then selects the right tests from a team's existing suites to cover the impacted code paths. Where coverage is missing, Covlant's quality agents generate and validate new tests, so only meaningful, trustworthy tests are run. Engineers and QA teams stay in control through a clear review experience that shows what was tested, what passed or failed, and why.
 




  






 The result is faster feedback loops, leaner regression cycles, lower test\-maintenance overhead, and greater confidence in every release. Covlant fits into the tools teams already use across their CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
 




  






 We're an early\-stage company working with enterprise engineering and QA teams, and we're growing our team in Bangalore. Joining Covlant now means shaping how the product is positioned, sold, and adopted, working closely with founders, Product, and Engineering, and helping define a new category in software quality.
 




  




**Role \- Presales Engineer** 

  






 Covlant is hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
 




  






 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate Covlant’s capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
 




  




**Key responsibilities** 

  




* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria.

title: Sr Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Job Description: Solution Engineer – Context Graph Demo Specialist**
**Company:** 
 Tata Communications
   

  

**Function:** 
 Solution Engineering
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor (IC)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Fresher – 2 years
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram
   

  

**Travel:** 
 40–50% (on\-site customer demos)
   

  

**About The Role**
 Tata Communications is looking for an early\-career Solution Engineer to join the Solution Engineering team, focused on building and delivering demonstrations of our Context Graph capabilities. This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role for someone who enjoys translating technical concepts into compelling business stories, thinks logically under pressure, and is comfortable being on the road to present in front of customers.
   

  

 You'll work closely with senior solution architects, product, and sales teams to build demo environments, customize them for specific customer use cases, and present them live — both virtually and on\-site.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Demo Build \& Ownership: Build, configure, and maintain demo environments for Context Graph, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and are tailored to different industry use cases.
* Customer\-Facing Demos: Travel to customer locations (40–50% travel) to deliver live product demonstrations, walk through use cases, and answer first\-level technical questions.
* Use Case Translation: Work with sales and solution architects to understand a prospect's business problem and translate it into a relevant, believable demo narrative — not just a feature walkthrough.
* Troubleshooting on the Fly: Diagnose and resolve demo environment issues quickly, including during live customer sessions, with a calm and structured approach.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to stay current on roadmap changes, feedback loops from the field, and competitive positioning.
* Documentation: Maintain demo scripts, environment setup guides, and reusable assets so demos can scale across the team.
* Continuous Learning: Build depth in graph data concepts, knowledge graphs, and how Context Graph fits into broader enterprise data and AI strategies.


**Must\-Have**
**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (freshers welcome) or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Strong logical and analytical thinking — able to break down a customer problem and map it to a technical solution.
* Ontology\-first thinking — demonstrated ability to model an enterprise’s objects, actions and processes as a reusable semantic layer, with metadata, permissions and data structures kept consistent, secure, and scalable Ontology.
* Basic understanding of data structures, databases, or graph concepts (formal experience not required, but genuine curiosity and aptitude expected).
* Good business acumen — able to understand a customer's commercial context, not just their technical ask.
* Comfortable with public speaking / presenting to small and large groups, including senior stakeholders.
* Willingness and ability to travel 40–50% of the time for on\-site customer demos.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.


**Good To Have (not Mandatory)**
* Exposure to graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, etc.) or knowledge graph concepts.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, or basic scripting.
* Prior internship or project experience involving customer\-facing work, hackathons, or product demos.
* Understanding of enterprise IT, telecom, or B2B SaaS environments.


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* Demo environments are reliable, current, and reusable across the team.
* Customers leave demo sessions with a clear understanding of how Context Graph solves their specific problem.
* You build a reputation internally as someone who can be trusted to represent the product in front of a customer.
* You progress toward owning more complex, custom\-built demos and eventually pre\-sales solutioning independently.


**Why Join Tata Communications**
* Front\-row seat to how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt cutting\-edge graph and AI\-driven solutions.
* Direct mentorship from senior solution architects and exposure to the full sales cycle.
* Fast\-tracked learning curve: technical depth \+ commercial exposure \+ customer\-facing skills, all in one role.
* Clear growth path into Solution Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Product roles.

title: Field Application Engineer, Verification
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Field Application Engineer, Verification
* Senior Applications Engineer, RTL Signoff
* Customer Success Engineer, Verification Solutions
* Technical Application Engineer, Design Verification
* Solutions Engineer, Verification and Low Power


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in RTL verification flows and you have learned that the hardest problems are rarely the ones in the datasheet. They show up three weeks before tapeout when a CDC violation surfaces in a corner case no one thought to model, or when a low power domain interaction breaks in ways the testbench never caught. You live for those moments because solving them well is what keeps chips from respinning.
   

  

 You are equally comfortable reading SystemVerilog assertions, walking a customer through a SpyGlass run, and sitting with an R\&D team to explain why a methodology needs to flex for a real design. You do not wait for someone to hand you a script. You write it, test it, and then show the customer how to own it themselves.
   

  

 Working across time zones does not faze you. Neither does jumping into a customer war room when a project is stuck. You know that adoption is not about features, it is about trust, and trust comes from showing up, understanding the problem, and delivering something that actually moves the schedule forward. At Synopsys, you will work with semiconductor teams building the chips that power everything, and what you enable will matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor design teams across the region to deploy and optimize Synopsys verification solutions including VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, and Verdi
* Debug complex RTL signoff issues in customer designs, CDC violations, lint errors, RDC problems, low power UPF conflicts, and formal property failures, and turn those into repeatable methodology improvements
* Partner with Synopsys R\&D and product validation teams to develop new flows, reproduce customer issues, and drive tool enhancements that solve real tapeout blockers
* Lead technical engagements during critical project phases, onsite or remote, ensuring customers hit their verification milestones and tapeout schedules
* Gather requirements from customer feedback and design challenges, translate them into flow improvements, and work with product teams to prioritize and track delivery
* Coordinate with account managers and technical account managers to shape customer strategies, drive tool adoption, and support business growth across your accounts
* Train customer engineering teams on verification methodologies, tool usage, and best practices that reduce verification cycle time and improve signoff quality


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to close CDC, lint, and low power signoff weeks or months faster by deploying the right methodology at the right time in their flow
* Reduce customer respins by catching critical RTL issues early, before they reach gate\-level or silicon
* Drive adoption of Synopsys verification tools across new projects and teams, expanding footprint and deepening technical relationships with key accounts
* Influence Synopsys product roadmaps by surfacing real customer pain points and working with R\&D to deliver features that matter
* Build repeatable flows and reference methodologies that scale across multiple customer projects and design teams
* Strengthen customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by being the engineer they call when something breaks and needs to get fixed now
* Contribute to the success of chips powering AI, automotive, mobile, and cloud infrastructure by ensuring verification does not become the bottleneck


 What You'll Need
   

  

* BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or Microelectronics with 3\-5 years of hands\-on industry experience in ASIC design or verification
* Strong command of VHDL, Verilog, and SystemVerilog RTL, and a solid understanding of ASIC design and verification flows from RTL to tapeout
* Proven experience with RTL signoff flows including linting, Clock Domain Crossing (CDC), Reset Domain Crossing (RDC), and property checking using static and formal verification tools
* Hands\-on work with low power verification techniques using UPF or CPF, and experience debugging power intent issues in real designs
* Exposure to simulation and verification methodologies including directed tests, constrained random testing, assertions, coverage\-driven verification, and gate\-level simulation (GLS)
* Working knowledge of Synopsys EDA tools such as VC SpyGlass, VCS, VC LP, VC Formal, FishTail, or Verdi is a strong plus
* Comfort working in ambiguity, you can take a vague customer problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into a clear technical plan


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification challenge, and sketch out a solution approach on the whiteboard that the team actually believes in
* You are the kind of engineer who does not just report a tool issue, you create a minimal reproducible test case, propose a workaround, and follow up until it is resolved
* Working across global teams and time zones does not slow you down, you coordinate effectively, keep stakeholders aligned, and do not let details fall through the cracks
* You know how to explain a complex CDC violation or formal proof failure to a design lead in a way that makes sense without oversimplifying the technical reality
* You build relationships by being reliable, when you say you will deliver a flow or a debug session, it happens
* You are curious about what is coming next in chip design, AI workloads, automotive safety, advanced nodes, and you want to be part of enabling it


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Customer Success Group, a global team that partners directly with semiconductor companies to solve high\-value verification and design problems. The team works closely with R\&D, product validation, account management, and technical account managers to drive adoption of Synopsys solutions and ensure customer projects succeed through tapeout. You will be part of a regional applications engineering team supporting customers across India, collaborating with engineers worldwide, and contributing to methodologies that scale across the business.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

* Resolve onboarding bottlenecks and accelerate go\-live timelines.


****Network Expansion \& Activation****

* Ensure newly onboarded distributors are operationally ready and successfully activated.
* Track onboarding funnel, conversion metrics and activation milestones.


****Stakeholder Management****

* Collaborate with Brand, Operations, Supply Chain and Analytics teams to execute expansion plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact throughout the onboarding journey.


****Market Intelligence****
* Develop a strong understanding of regional distributor ecosystems.
* Track competitor distributor strategies, market dynamics and expansion opportunities.
* Bring insights that improve Meesho's distributor acquisition strategy.


**What You Will Need**
* Experience
+ 2\-6 years of experience in Business Development, Distributor Development, Channel Sales, Supply Expansion or Merchant Acquisition.
+ Experience working with FMCG, consumer brands, retail distribution, B2B commerce or marketplaces is preferred.


**Preferred Backgrounds**
* Distributor/channel development roles in FMCG companies.
* Professionals with experience onboarding distributors, dealers, wholesalers or large retail partners.


****Skills \& Attributes****
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable engaging with business owners, promoters and senior decision\-makers.
* High ownership with the ability to independently drive closures.
* Excellent communication in English, Hindi and regional languages (preferred based on territory).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Working knowledge of Excel and CRM tools.


****Travel Requirement****
* Extensive travel is mandatory.
* Candidates should be comfortable spending approximately 75% of their time (3 out of every 4 weeks) travelling across cities and states to identify, evaluate and onboard distributors.
* Flexibility to relocate temporarily based on business priorities is an added advantage.


****Why Join Us?****
 This role offers the opportunity to build supply infrastructure at national scale. If you enjoy solving real\-world business problems, travelling extensively, negotiating with entrepreneurs, and creating long\-term impact by building networks from scratch, this role provides a unique platform to do so.
   

  

**About Us**
 Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
   

  

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor \- our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**
****Our Mission****
 Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e\-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
   

  

 We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state\-of\-the\-art tech infrastructure, and pan\-India logistics network through trusted third\-party partners.
   

  

 Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi\-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e\-commerce ecosystem.
   

  

****Culture and Total Rewards****
 Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people\-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
   

  

 Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non\-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
   

  

 We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity\-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee\-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness\-related perks.
   

  

 To support work\-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop reusable solution assets, reference architectures, proposal templates, battle cards, and demo environments.
* Enable Sales teams through technical training, competitive positioning, and product education.
* Support strategic RFPs, RFIs, and enterprise proposal responses with differentiated technical content.







**Product \& Engineering Collaboration** 



* Act as the Voice of the Customer by providing structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams.
* Influence product roadmap based on customer requirements, competitive insights, and emerging AI trends.
* Collaborate on developing solution accelerators and industry\-specific offerings.
* Market Intelligence
* Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, GPU Cloud, Cloud Computing, Networking, Kubernetes, Enterprise Infrastructure, and MLOps.
* Monitor competitive offerings and market trends to strengthen Neysa's positioning and technical differentiation.







**Team Leadership** 



* Hire, mentor, and develop a world\-class Presales team.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession.
* Build capability development programs and establish career growth frameworks for the team.



**Qualifications** 




 Experience
 


* 12–18 years of experience in Enterprise Presales, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Technical Sales.
* At least 5 years of experience leading high\-performing Presales or Solution Consulting teams.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise sales teams in AI, Cloud, Infrastructure, SaaS, or Data Center technologies.
* Demonstrated success in influencing and closing large, complex enterprise deals.







**Technical Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of:
* AI Infrastructure and GPU Computing
* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Hybrid and Multi\-Cloud Architectures
* Kubernetes, Containers, and Virtualization
* Enterprise Networking and Security
* MLOps, Data Platforms, and AI Deployment Frameworks
* High Performance Computing (HPC)







**Leadership \& Business Skills** 



* Strong executive presence with exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Customer\-first mindset with strong consultative selling capabilities.
* Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial outcomes.
* Strong analytical thinking and strategic problem\-solving skills.







**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* MBA is an added advantage.
* Preferred Certifications
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Certifications
* Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD)
* AI/ML Certifications
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications are a plus.



**Why Join Neysa?** 








 At Neysa.ai, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt AI by leading one of the most strategic customer\-facing functions in the company. You'll work alongside industry leaders to build a world\-class Presales organization, influence product direction, and help customers unlock transformative business outcomes through AI.
 







 This is an opportunity to lead at the intersection of technology, innovation, and business—building technical sales excellence for one of India's fastest\-growing AI Cloud companies. If you're passionate about AI, enterprise technology, and creating high\-impact customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.
 







 Lead the technical vision behind AI transformation. Build the future with Neysa.
 



 www.neysa.ai

title: GN I&E S&P Data Center Consultant
description:
**Accenture \| Industry and Enterprise Software and Platforms**
**Role: Data Center Network Consultant**
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune,
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About Us**
 Accenture is a leading technology consulting firm specializing in data center transformation and infrastructure optimization. We partner with hyperscalers, enterprises, and colocation providers to design scalable, efficient data center networks that support AI workloads, edge computing, and sustainable operations.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a seasoned Data Center Network Strategy Consultant to lead strategic planning for next\-generation data center infrastructures. You will evaluate existing data center fabrics, recommend modernization paths, and develop roadmaps that optimize for density, latency, power efficiency, and resilience. The ideal candidate combines deep data center expertise with consulting skills to deliver strategies to clients that reduce TCO and enable business agility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform in\-depth assessments of data center networks, including spine\-leaf architectures, top\-of\-rack switching, and interconnects for multi\-site fabrics.
* Design strategic roadmaps for data center evolution, integrating 400G/800G Ethernet, RDMA, liquid cooling, and sustainable power systems.
* Collaborate with C\-suite executives, managers, and engineering teams to align network strategies with capacity planning, migration to liquid\-cooled DCs, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Lead client workshops, RFx evaluations for DC vendors (e.g., Arista, NVIDIA, Schneider Electric), and PoCs for high\-performance fabrics.
* Analyze trends in AI\-driven workloads, edge data centers, and regulations (e.g., carbon reporting) to recommend future\-proof designs.
* Build financial models projecting ROI on DC expansions, including CapEx/OpEx for power, cooling, and network upgrades.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to thought leadership on data center whitepapers and conferences.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with GPU clustering for AI, and sustainable DC designs (e.g., PUE optimization), zero\-trust DC security.
* Background in hyperscale, colocation, or financial services data centers.
* Deep expertise in data center strategy, fleet operations, infrastructure consulting, and cloud transformation.
* Proficiency in DC modeling tools (e.g., 6Wind, Visio) and methodologies like TOGAF for enterprise architecture.
* Proven ability to present complex DC strategies to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled
 **Solution Engineer** 
 to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI\-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre\-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.
   

  





**Pre\-Sales Engagement \& Customer Solutions:**



* Engage with SMB, mid\-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.
* Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.



**AI Solutioning \& Positioning:**



* Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over\-selling or over\-simplifying.
* Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.
* Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent\-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.
* Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.



**Solution Design \& Documentation:**



* Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.
* Create technical documentation including solution proposals, SoWs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Evaluate opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint and proactively mitigate risks.



**Collaboration \& Execution:**



* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.
* Align technical strategies with sales initiatives to accelerate deal closures.
* Continuously improve pre\-sales tools, processes, and enablement assets.



**Customer Advocacy \& Product Evangelism:**



* Articulate the value and capabilities of the Freshworks platform to both technical and business audiences.
* Represent Freshworks at customer meetings, events, and forums as a trusted technical advisor.
* Keep abreast of product developments and industry trends to provide relevant, up\-to\-date guidance.


**Qualifications**
* **5–8 years** 
 of experience in pre\-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer\-facing technical role.
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise software environments.
* Proven experience designing and delivering technical demonstrations and POCs.
* Ability to work with mid\-market and enterprise customers, understand their pain points, and craft effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Familiarity with ITSM products and market is a must.
* Solid conceptual understanding of AI/LLM technology — prompting, RAG, agentic workflows, and how AI features are typically integrated into SaaS products; hands\-on experience configuring or building AI agents/copilots (e.g., Agent Studio, similar low\-code agent builders, or LLM APIs) is strongly preferred.
* Ability to credibly position and sell AI value to both business and technical stakeholders, including addressing common AI concerns (accuracy, data privacy, change management).
* This is a Night Shift role only, prior North America Market experience is a must



**Key Skills:**



* Pre\-sales consulting \& technical storytelling
* Solution architecture \& demo delivery
* API, integrations, SaaS product understanding
* Discovery, qualification \& objection handling
* RFP/RFI response and technical documentation
* Stakeholder collaboration (Sales/Product/Engineering)
* Strong communication \& relationship\-building
* AI/LLM concepts (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) \& positioning
* Hands\-on AI agent/copilot building (Agent Studio or equivalent)


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

title: Engineer - Application Engineering
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



 As a member of our team, you'll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary\-pushing every day. You'll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today's solutions are built for tomorrow's challenges.
 



 In this role, you will lead Asia Pacific RSEC initiatives and execute sales process by working closely with the AP Sales team, to achieve a high percentage success (Book to Quote rate %) in securing business.Plan, manage, participate, lead and train the Sales team and our representatives to be highly proficient in product selection to best fit the customer enquiries whilst maximising the Armstrong product content and upsell to fit the enquiry opportunity. You will travel within the Asia Pacific region on an ad hoc basis meeting customers for technical discussions, Presentations, Business meetings, trainings etc.)
 



  





 In addition to annual initiatives, the key accountabilities of this position are:
 


* **Customer Enquiry Evaluation and Product Fit Optimization**



 Evaluation of customer enquiries involves scrutinizing P\&I drawings to understand the design and application intent. This assessment helps in determining the best\-fit Armstrong product or solution to optimize efficiency.
 


* **Collaborative Sales Engagement**



 Working closely with sales management and field sales ensures early engagement and design/applications dialogue at crucial points in the customer buying process. This collaborative approach aligns with Armstrong's sales process and best practices, fostering a smooth and effective customer interaction.
 


* **Support in Enquiry Follow\-Up and Solution Development**



 Support is provided for following up on enquiries with both external sales teams and specific internal quotations. For more complex project opportunities, as designated and agreed upon with sales leadership, we actively participate in customer dialogue as part of solution development, tender clarification, benefit articulation, and ultimately assisting in securing business.
 


* **Product Selection and Quotation Preparation**



 Appropriate products are selected and quotations prepared using company product selection tools. Ensuring that all supporting documentation, value articulation information, and quotation packages meet the desired quality standards identified by the business is crucial.
 


* **Strategic Planning and Sales Closure Collaboration**



 Participation in the production of the strategic planning (SOMA) sheet on selected jobs involves working closely with sales managers to help achieve successful closure. It ensures that all relevant information and strategies are aligned, facilitating efficient and effective sales closure.
 


* **Contribution to Departmental KPIs and Business Objectives**



 Active participation and contribution to department key business metrics/KPIs are essential to meeting overall business objectives.
 


* **Sales Meetings and Strategic Initiative Contributions**



 As a representative of the RSEC, participation in regional and national sales meetings is crucial. Assistance in the compilation and review of sales forecasts, strategic initiatives (e.g., CPDs), and key account customers ensures that our sales strategies are well\-informed and aligned with the company's overall objectives.
 


* **Client Engagement and Message Integration**



 Undertaking site/client visits ensures that the Armstrong message is articulated and understood by our client base. By integrating our offerings into their specifications and schedules, we demonstrate our commitment to their success and position Armstrong as a valued partner.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





**To thrive in this role, you should bring:** 




  




* Qualification within Building Services/Mechanical Engineering (Degree Preferred)
* High degree of fluency in P\&I drawings in mechanical / HVAC applications with consulting background are preferred.
* Technical product knowledge of the company’s current product range
* 8\-10 years’ experience in a technical sales role as an internal sales or on a customer orientated technical team is essential (desirable)
* Knowledge and understanding of the company’s internal sales systems would be desirable
* Competent in IT skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent customer service skills
* The ability to collate and analyse relevant data \& statistics (data/analysis manipulation – MS advanced level)
* The ability to write reports/complete paperwork accurately and legibly
* Initiative, self\-motivation and commitment to achieving high standards of quality and efficiency
* A pro\-active and flexible attitude
* Business systems knowledge – Configuration software / CRM \- advantageous



  





**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** 




 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: AI Architect Senior Advisor
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

 AI Architect Senior Advisor
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a senior, customer\-facing practitioner who connects customer needs, measurable business outcomes, and technology solutions. Working directly within customer environments, the FDE partners with business and technical stakeholders to understand complex challenges, reduce ambiguity, make opportunities tangible, and establish a credible path from idea to production value.
   

  

 The FDE combines depth in a relevant specialist discipline with broad knowledge of company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, and reusable assets. They apply domain context, technical judgement, and commercial awareness to identify high\-impact opportunities and determine the most appropriate route to the customer outcome, including bespoke AI delivery, product capabilities, platform or infrastructure services, and reuse of existing assets.
   

  

 The FDE acts as the persistent outcome thread between customer stakeholders and internal engineering, product, architecture, delivery, and operations teams. They shape validated opportunities into delivery\-ready work, remain connected through implementation and adoption, and use customer feedback and production evidence to guide improvement without replacing the accountable production delivery or managed service teams.
   

  

 Combining domain understanding, technical credibility, strong client emotional intelligence, and outcome leadership, the FDE operates independently in ambiguous enterprise environments and is trusted to lead complex customer engagements. The role requires hands\-on problem solving, sound judgement, effective stakeholder influence, and the ability to orchestrate the right capabilities while maintaining focus on measurable customer value and scalable delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflow challenges, desired outcomes, and the measures that will demonstrate success.
* Lead discovery, assessment, and solution\-shaping activities that translate ambiguous business needs into clear, prioritised opportunities.
* Establish outcome hypotheses, success measures, key assumptions, and customer ownership before recommending material investment or progression.
* Create or direct rapid prototypes, proof points, experiments, and demonstrations that test the assumptions most critical to value and feasibility.
* Assess solution feasibility across AI, data, integration, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, operational readiness, and cost considerations.
* Shape validated opportunities into production\-ready work, including target workflow, architecture direction, prioritised backlog, dependencies, acceptance direction, estimates, and mobilisation requirements.
* Build trusted relationships with technical, business, and senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and constructive challenge throughout customer engagements.
* Collaborate across engineering, architecture, product, delivery, operations, industry, transformation, and account teams to orchestrate the capabilities required for successful outcomes.
* Analyze and resolve complex business, technical, and operational challenges using sound judgement, evidence, and structured problem\-solving.
* Identify high\-value use cases by combining domain context, stakeholder insight, technology capability, feasibility, and measurable business impact.
* Determine the most appropriate delivery route, including AI Studio, company products, AI Factory, transformation services, partner capabilities, reuse, further validation, or stop.
* Maintain the outcome thread as work moves into delivery by validating major decisions, assumptions, user feedback, adoption needs, and continued alignment to the intended value.
* Capture field feedback, implementation learning, defects, feature requests, customer signals, and reusable patterns from customer engagements.
* Contribute to internal IP, accelerators, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, reusable assets, and continuous improvement of the Forward Deployed and AI Studio methods.
* Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to FDE Candidates and delivery practitioners to strengthen capability and successful outcomes.
* Role may require working at customer sites, company offices, or hybrid delivery locations depending on engagement needs.


**Knowledge and Attributes**
* Strong domain awareness with the ability to understand customer workflows, value drivers, operating constraints, industry context, and relevant success measures.
* Strong technical credibility across enterprise solution architecture, engineering practices, data, integration, cloud platforms, and production technology delivery.
* Applied understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, automation, model and tool integration, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of production AI considerations including evaluation, security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, AgentOps, FinOps, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Strong client emotional intelligence, consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly in senior customer environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making capabilities.
* Deep working expertise in at least one relevant specialist area such as AI engineering, architecture, industry, transformation, product, data, or AI infrastructure.
* Broad knowledge of relevant company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, implementation methods, and reusable assets, and when to apply them.
* Ability to learn and apply domain context quickly, including processes, terminology, regulations, data flows, user roles, constraints, and business metrics.
* Commercial awareness to connect technical choices with business value, risk, cost, time to value, adoption, and the appropriate delivery model.
* Strong outcome leadership, including the ability to define measurable outcomes, surface assumptions, prioritise evidence, and drive Build, Iterate, Route, or Stop decisions.
* Strong reuse and product\-feedback mindset, including the ability to distinguish customer\-specific needs from patterns and improvements that should be scaled.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly with domain, business, executive, engineering, architecture, and operational stakeholders using the appropriate level of detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively, and balance business, technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders across multiple organizational levels without relying on formal authority.
* Strong collaboration, relationship\-building, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a bias toward creating customer and practice capability rather than individual dependency.


**Required Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Relevant industry certifications in cloud technologies, solution architecture, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, agile delivery, industry domains, or related disciplines are beneficial. Certifications support but do not replace demonstrated FDE capability and accreditation.


**Required Experience**
* Typically 8\+ years of relevant experience in software or AI engineering, solution architecture, consulting, customer engineering, product engineering, industry transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines, with equivalent demonstrated depth considered.
* Significant experience working directly with enterprise customers and building credibility with business, technical, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience independently leading discovery, problem framing, solution shaping, or complex customer workstreams in ambiguous environments.
* Experience creating or directing prototypes, proof points, technical experiments, or working solutions to validate customer and technology assumptions.
* Experience shaping and delivering enterprise technology solutions involving architecture, data, integration, security, deployment, and production constraints.
* Experience applying domain or functional context to customer workflows, constraints, KPIs, value drivers, and solution decisions.
* Experience connecting technology decisions to measurable customer outcomes, adoption, business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, or customer experience.
* Experience collaborating with product, engineering, platform, industry, transformation, delivery, and business teams to determine the right solution and delivery route.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, reuse, product, partner, and platform options pragmatically rather than defaulting to bespoke implementation.
* Experience operating within complex enterprise environments and navigating dependencies across technology, data, governance, operations, and customer organizations.
* Experience operating independently, exercising sound judgement, influencing decisions, and maintaining momentum through uncertainty and changing priorities.
* Experience capturing reusable patterns, field feedback, lessons learned, methodologies, accelerators, or other assets that improve future delivery.
* Experience providing guidance, mentoring, peer review, or knowledge sharing to colleagues and developing practitioners.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Technical Account Consultant - Benefits
description:
******About Rippling******
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

******About Rippling******
 Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.
   

  

 By connecting every workforce system to a single source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employee’s payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (\#12 out of 500\)
   

  

******About The Role******
 You are the "Benefits Expert" for Rippling's customers.
   

  

 You’ll expertly navigate and and enable customers with Ripplings Benefits products, including Benadmin for the US and Canada, Flex Benefits, PEO, and HR Services. You’ll provide insightful guidance on best practices for benefits management, advocate thoughtfully for your customers' benefits needs, and build trusted relationships with HR/Benefits administrators. If this sounds exciting, great – you'll be doing all of that each day!
   

  

******What You Will Do******
* Project Manage: Collaborate with various teams internally and externally to execute project engagements and help customers optimize their use of Rippling's benefits solutions.
* Drive enablement: Encourage customer enablement of key benefits features and timelines while consulting with them on best practices to seamlessly integrate Rippling into their HR workflows.

* Become a product expert: Be the go\-to resource for both customers and coworkers on Rippling's benefits products by your 90th day.


******What You Will Need******
* 3\+ years of SaaS experience in customer success, consulting, implementation, or support.
* Preferred: 3\+ years of experience with benefits products, enabling customers with benadmin, Flex benefits, PEO, and HR Services.
* Passion for helping customers and colleagues succeed in benefits management.
* Ruthless prioritization and time management skills.
* Master project/task manager – you never drop the ball.
* Ability to explain complex scenarios in simple, clear written or verbal communications.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent HR problems.
* Interest in actively working with product and engineering teams.


 Even if you don’t meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply. Skills can be used in lots of different ways and your life and professional experience may be relevant beyond what a list of requirements will capture.
   

  

******About The Team******
 The TAC team is a team of experts tasked with assisting our clients with enabling admins and optimizing complex use cases across the Rippling product suite. We have experts in the Finance, Benefits, Talent, IT, Platform and Multi\-EIN specialties. Our team is spread across the world! We often collaborate with Account Managers (AMs) and Technical Account Managers (TAMs) when determining which clients to engage with. Over the last two years our team has seen substantial growth. In 2024, we have doubled our team and are looking forward to continuing to add to our team of specialists!
