title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer (FPGA, RTL Design & Emulation)
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half\-fixed bothers you.
   

  

 You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.
   

  

 Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R\&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
* Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
* Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
* Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi\-FPGA partitioning and hardware\-software co\-verification
* Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R\&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real\-world usage patterns
* Support pre\-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
* Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R\&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert\-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
* Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
* Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self\-sufficient with the toolchain
* Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
* Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2\-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1\-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
* Hands\-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
* Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back\-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
* Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
* Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware\-software integration
* Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can take a vague customer complaint like "the compile is failing" and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R\&D can act on it
* You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
* You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
* You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
* You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
* You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert\-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R\&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre\-sales evaluation through post\-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.

title: ITO Sourcing Engineer - Engineered Equipment (API Pump)
description:
Celeros Flow Technology, LLC
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Proposal Sourcing Engineer \- Supplier\-Engineered Equipment supports Celeros Flow Technology's Inquiry\-to\-Order (ITO) process by developing supplier strategies and commercial solutions that improve proposal win rates, competitiveness, margin, and lead\-time optimization.
   

  

 Working closely with Application Engineering, Commercial Operations, and Sales teams, the Proposal Sourcing Leader serves as the primary supplier\-facing commercial lead during the proposal phase. The role is responsible for developing sourcing strategies, negotiating supplier commitments, assessing commercial and supply chain risks, and strengthening customer proposals through collaborative supplier engagement.
   

  

 Supplier\-Engineered Equipment is externally engineered and manufactured equipment supplied against Celeros performance and interface requirements. Celeros defines what the equipment must do and how it must integrate with the overall solution, while suppliers are responsible for detailed design, engineering, and manufacture. Typical examples include electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), mechanical seal systems, lubrication systems, gearboxes, and other auxiliary equipment. This role will be based at Bangalore location
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Proposal Competitiveness
   

  

* Develop supplier strategies and commercial solutions that improve proposal win rates, margin, and lead\-time optimization.
* Influence proposal outcomes through supplier engagement, commercial negotiation, and market intelligence.
* Support proposal reviews by providing sourcing recommendations, commercial insights, and risk assessments.
* Identify opportunities to improve proposal competitiveness and increase probability of award.


 Supplier Engagement
   

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers of Supplier\-Engineered Equipment.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, contractual terms, warranty provisions, and commercial commitments that strengthen customer proposals.
* Develop competitive sourcing alternatives that improve customer value propositions.
* Monitor supplier capabilities, capacity constraints, market conditions, and industry developments.


 Commercial and Contractual Risk Management
   

  

* Evaluate supplier commercial offerings, contractual commitments, and supply chain risks.
* Identify and mitigate commercial, schedule, capacity, and execution risks during proposal development.
* Support the development of executable and commercially sound customer solutions.
* Provide commercial guidance regarding supplier terms and conditions, warranties, qualifications, and risk allocation.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with Application Engineering, Commercial Operations, Sales, and Supply Chain teams throughout the Inquiry\-to\-Order process.
* Support development of technically compliant and commercially competitive customer solutions.
* Translate complex supplier, commercial, technical, and supply chain issues into concise business\-focused recommendations and executive\-level summaries.
* Ensure effective transfer of supplier commitments, assumptions, and risks from proposal teams to execution teams.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to develop sourcing strategies that improve proposal win rates, commercial competitiveness, margin, and lead\-time competitiveness.
* Strong negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to secure commercially advantageous pricing, lead times, contractual terms, and supplier commitments.
* Working knowledge of commercial contracts, supplier agreements, terms and conditions, warranties, risk allocation, and related contractual language.
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills with the ability to effectively engage suppliers, cross\-functional teams, and leadership at all organizational levels, including supplier executive management.
* Ability to simplify complex technical, commercial, and supply chain topics into concise business\-focused recommendations and executive\-level summaries.
* Strong analytical and business judgment skills with the ability to assess supplier offerings, commercial opportunities, contractual exposure, and supply chain risks and recommend actions that improve proposal outcomes.
* Ability to interpret customer specifications and supplier technical proposals sufficiently to support commercial decision\-making.
* Understanding of rotating equipment and Supplier\-Engineered Equipment, including electric motors, VFDs, mechanical seal systems, lubrication systems, and gearboxes.
* Ability to manage multiple proposal opportunities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.


 Education and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years in proposal management, applications engineering, strategic sourcing, commercial operations, supply chain, or similar roles within an engineered\-to\-order manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in Inquiry\-to\-Order (ITO), tendering, proposal development, or bid\-management activities.
* Background negotiating with suppliers and evaluating commercial terms, contractual commitments, and supplier risk.
* Familiarity with rotating equipment, Supplier\-Engineered Equipment, or related industrial products.
* Exposure to customer\-facing commercial activities and collaboration within global cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and SAP or equivalent ERP systems preferred.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Contribution to proposal win rates.
* Commercial competitiveness of supplier solutions.

title: Technical Account Manager -MendixRapidMiner (MXRM), India
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 This role is
 **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** 
 with responsibilities as single post\-sale technical owner of adoption and scale across the customer's footprint in the four products of the specialized GTM for Software, Data and AI — the ICX trio (Mendix, Graph Studio, AI Cloud) and SLC. The mission is to convert sold software into realized technical value and grow that footprint, account by account, holding only a basic understanding of the wider Siemens portfolio — enough to spot and route adjacent opportunities.
   

  

 Advisor\-first: guide adoption, drive the customer's software, data and AI teams to self\-sufficiency, and own the architectural view of how these products fit their landscape. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor. Ring\-fenced from owning commercial, support and delivery — contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation, never the process.
   

  

 Every TAM is a technical practitioner — hands\-on capable and credible in the products and the customer's architecture, able to prototype and prove things in the tooling. How much a TAM builds themselves, versus pulls Specialists in for the heavy build, varies with their product depth and the account. Every TAM is also well trained in the use of generative AI in day\-to\-day work, applying it to work faster and raise the quality of their output.
   

  

 A gated resource on designated accounts only (strategic designation, expansion potential or technical complexity — not ARR), spanning the industrial and non\-industrial customer base; intensity scales with the stakes of the account. The TAM is the field's channel into the Product organization — the natural bridge to the Field CTO — carrying structured voice\-of\-customer upstream into the roadmap and roadmap context back. Primary technical contact for the account; never the commercial or retention contact.
   

  

* Essential Functions
* Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders — CIO/CTO, enterprise architects and key business stakeholders — as the account's strategic technical advisor.
* Run joint technical account planning with the AE, Partner AE and Partner Manager; align adoption and footprint\-growth priorities.
* Maintain a current view of the customer's software architecture and landscape; advise how the four products integrate, partnering with customer\-side and Siemens architects.
* Translate the sold solution into a technical adoption roadmap aligned to the customer's software, data and AI strategy.
* Responsible for capturing the above in a Customer Adoption Plan, and drive progress, collaboration and alignment based on that.
* Adoption \& Technical Execution
* Run the technical kickoff with the customer's software, data and AI teams; turn the sold solution into an adoption plan and hand\-shake with Expert Services on implementation.
* Drive adoption enablement (workshops, office hours) toward customer self\-sufficiency; run a recurring technical account\-review cadence, tracking adoption health and surfacing risks early.
* Get hands\-on to prototype use\-cases and lightly integrate to unblock rollouts — how much depends on your product depth and the account; pull Specialists in for heavy build.
* Collaborate with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation — align on adoption and surface needs, never own delivery.
* Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
* Surface and shape new technical use\-cases; design for the next workload and scale.
* Spot opportunities across the four products and wider Siemens portfolio; route them to the account team and hand qualified commercial signal to the AE.
* Contribute deep technical input on architecture and implementation to bids and RFx (typically expansion on covered accounts); the sales/bid team owns the process.
* Internal Operations \& Orchestration
* Track adoption health and technical pipeline for covered accounts; contribute to account planning and internal reviews.
* Orchestrate across AE / Partner AE / Partner Manager / Specialists / Expert Services; triage when to pull Specialists.
* Use and promote internal tools to capture and reuse materials.
* Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
* Build an internal knowledge network and share adoption best practices.
* Contribute to adoption playbooks, reference architectures and supporting tools.
* Coach and mentor other TAMs and team members.
* Field Signal \& Product Feedback
* As the field's channel into Product, capture structured field signal from live adoption and feed it to the Field CTO; carry roadmap context back to the customer.
* Represent the customer's technical needs and adoption blockers internally; escalate and advocate.
* General \- Uphold Siemens' integrity, culture, values and compliance (health, safety, quality); complete required administration including timely expenses; undertake other reasonable duties as required.
* Outcomes \& Measures \- What a successful TAM delivers, per function area — outcomes, not activity.


 Function area: Technical Account Strategy \& Planning
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): A current, shared technical account plan and architecture view the account team acts on
   

  

 Function area: Adoption \& Technical Execution
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Sold software reaches productive use; the customer's teams become self\-sufficient
   

  

 Function area: Footprint Growth \& Bid Support
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): New technical use\-cases surfaced and qualified; expansion is technically de\-risked
   

  

 Function area: Internal Operations \& Orchestration
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Account team, Specialists and Expert Services orchestrated without gaps or duplication
   

  

 Function area: Knowledge Sharing \& Mentoring
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Adoption know\-how compounds across the team rather than living in one head
   

  

 Function area: Field Signal \& Product Feedback
   

  

 Outcome (what good looks like): Structured field signal reliably reaches Product; customers see themselves in the roadmap
   

  

**Role Interfaces**
 The TAM is the technical hub of the post\-sale account team. It hands qualified expansion signal, adoption status and technical input to the Account Executive (who owns the commercial deal, negotiation and quota) and takes back commercial strategy and account priorities. It aligns adoption with Expert Services (Siemens or partner), who own implementation and delivery — never the TAM. It triages and pulls Specialists for deep engineering and heavy build, feeds adoption\-health signal to Renewal Specialists (who own renewals and retention), and partners with Partner AE / Partner Managers on joint planning without managing the partner commercial relationship. It advises customer\-side architects on how the four products integrate into their landscape without owning their architecture decisions, and is the standing bridge to the Field CTO, carrying field signal upstream and roadmap context back. The wider customer\-success apparatus — QBRs, CSAT/NPS, success plans, upsell targets, renewals — sits with the AE, Renewal Specialists (and a CSM where engaged), never the TAM.
   

  

**We welcome applicants who meet the following criteria:**
* Product \& technical depth
* Deep expertise in the adoption and account discipline
* Adoption breadth across all four products
* Hands\-on technical capability — practitioner\-level depth; able to prototype, demo and work in the products (required of every TAM; how much you build yourself varies by product depth and account)
* Software, data \& AI delivery practices
* Wider Siemens portfolio awareness
* Account \& consultative
* Technical account planning
* Architectural advisory \& landscape mapping
* Senior stakeholder relationship management (CIO/CTO, enterprise architects, business stakeholders)
* Customer enablement \& facilitation
* Footprint growth / use\-case shaping
* Technical input to bids \& RFx
* Ways of working
* Orchestration \& cross\-team collaboration
* Voice\-of\-customer / structured feedback capture
* Communication \& storytelling
* Coaching \& mentoring
* Growth mindset \& self\-development
* Skilled, day\-to\-day use of generative AI to work faster and improve quality
* More hands\-on (deployment\-leaning) TAMs — additional
* Deeper retained expertise in one product
* Build and integrate more directly — spend more time hands\-on and pull Specialists in less


**Education \& Experience**
* A relevant university degree (computer science, software engineering, data/AI or related) or equivalent practical experience.
* A track record in post\-sale technical roles — solution/adoption consulting, technical account management, solution architecture or forward\-deployed engineering — with hands\-on familiarity with modern software, data and AI delivery.
* Depth in one or more of the four products is valued; breadth across them is built on the job. Genuine hands\-on technical capability is required of every TAM — credible practitioners who can get into the detail, not relationship managers; the amount of build work expected varies by product depth and account. Level\-specific requirements (years, depth, scope) are deferred to the future levelling pass.


**Working Conditions**
* Normal office or home\-office environment, with travel to customer sites as the account requires.
* Must be willing and available to work the core hours required for the role and its account coverage.


**We are Siemens**
 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! We offer a comprehensive reward package which includes a competitive basic salary, bonus scheme, generous holiday allowance, pension, and private healthcare.
   

  

 Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday with Us

While there is a possibility that the position may be made available to all Siemens employees through a future external posting, this is not guaranteed. title: DE-ET-Deployment Engineer Senior-GDS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position: Forward Deployed Engineer – Digital Engineering (Senior)**
 EY Consulting Digital Engineering is seeking highly skilled and customer focused Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to operate at the frontlines of enterprise transformation. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, platform architecture, AI\-led solutioning, and client value realization, requiring deep hands\-on technical expertise combined with strong consulting acumen.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an FDE in Digital Engineering, you will work directly with clients to co\-create, engineer, and scale AI\-first digital solutions that accelerate business outcomes. You will play a critical role in translating business problems into PDLC\-driven solutions, rapidly moving from POCs to enterprise\-grade platforms, and embedding GenAI, data, and cloud\-native engineering into core business workflows.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in driving future\-ready digital engineering capabilities across product engineering, platform modernization, and AI\-enabled transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Engagement \& Solution Delivery
   

  

* Partner with clients to shape business problems into solution hypotheses aligned to PDLC (Product Delivery Lifecycle).
* Drive co\-creation workshops, rapid prototyping, and outcome\-led solution design.
* Translate ambiguous requirements into architecture, data flows, and scalable engineering constructs.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions spanning discovery, POC, MVP, and enterprise\-scale rollout.
* Anchor business value realization (cycle time reduction, cost efficiency, productivity gains) as part of delivery.


**Engineering \& Development**
* Build AI\-first, cloud\-native applications and platforms using modern engineering practices.
* Develop accelerators, reusable components, and engineering patterns for repeatable delivery.
* Work across APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, and composable architectures.
* Integrate GenAI copilots, agents, and automation into enterprise workflows.
* Drive engineering excellence (performance, scalability, resilience, security).


 Emerging Technology Enablement
   

  

* Apply and scale cutting\-edge capabilities across:
+ Generative AI \& Agentic AI (LLMs, copilots, multi\-agent systems)
+ Data platforms \& real\-time intelligence
+ Cloud\-native \& platform engineering (Azure/AWS/GCP)
+ Automation \& intelligent workflows

* Evaluate, incubate, and industrialize new tools, frameworks, and accelerators within DE.
* Contribute to future readiness initiatives (e.g., advanced compute paradigms, next\-gen architectures).


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional squads (architects, data scientists, designers, and product teams).
* Provide technical leadership in FDE engagements, influencing architecture and delivery direction.
* Present value articulation, solution architecture, and outcomes to CXO and senior stakeholders.


**Deployment \& Support**
* Lead CI/CD, DevSecOps, and production rollout strategies.
* Ensure seamless transition from POC to scaled deployment across environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in client environments.
* Drive continuous optimization using telemetry, feedback, and usage insights.


**Soft Skills**
* Consulting excellence: Strong client engagement and storytelling skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Outcome orientation: Focus on measurable business impact, not just technical output.
* Architectural mindset: Ability to design modular, composable, scalable digital platforms.
* Bias for action: Thrive in ambiguity with a build\-first, iterate\-fast mindset.
* Leadership: Ability to guide teams, mentor engineers, and own delivery outcomes.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in digital/product engineering, solution architecture, or FDE/customer\-facing engineering roles.
* Strong programming expertise (Python, Java, JavaScript, Go or similar).
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience in distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Strong exposure to data engineering, pipelines, and modern data platforms.
* Proven experience in client\-facing engagements or consulting\-driven delivery models.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Experience working in AI\-led engineering / GenAI use cases / intelligent automation
* Exposure to PDLC, product\-centric delivery models, or platform engineering
* Experience building POCs and scaling them to enterprise\-grade solutions
* Strong problem\-solving and structured thinking approach
* High adaptability in fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY Digital Engineering, you will operate in a high\-impact, front\-line engineering model, solving real\-world business problems using AI, data, and platform engineering at scale.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Work on transformative FDE engagements with global clients
* Build industry\-leading AI\-led digital solutions
* Be part of next\-gen engineering transformation (GenAI, agentic systems, platformization)
* Gain access to continuous learning, innovation programs, and leadership opportunities


**EY Offers**
* A collaborative environment with global engineering talent and leadership
* Opportunities to drive end\-to\-end AI\-led transformation programs
* Flexible work culture with strong focus on innovation and growth


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer - PrimeTime
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent a decade or more in the trenches of silicon timing, and you know that the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips by three months often comes down to how well someone understands PrimeTime and can translate that knowledge into action for a stressed design team.
   

  

 You are equally comfortable running a competitive benchmark that proves tool superiority and sitting with a customer's design team walking through setup and hold violations in their actual netlist. You do not just know the theory of process corners and signal integrity, you have lived through the messiness of real designs where nothing is clean and every decision is a tradeoff. When a customer asks a hard question, you do not deflect, you dig in, and if you do not know the answer, you know exactly who in R\&D to pull in and how to frame the problem so it gets solved.
   

  

 You think in workflows, not features. Training is not about showing slides, it is about making sure the person leaves able to do the thing. At Synopsys, you will work with the team behind the industry\-leading STA tool and the customers who depend on it to ship the chips that power everything.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Drive PrimeTime adoption and usage with customers in both pre\-sales evaluations and post\-sales deployment, including competitive benchmarking, proof\-of\-concept runs, and technical win strategies
* Deliver hands\-on customer training on Static Timing Analysis workflows, timing closure techniques, process variation analysis, and signal integrity debugging using PrimeTime
* Provide tape\-out support for customer designs, troubleshooting timing violations, setup/hold issues, and corner\-case scenarios in real production environments
* Collaborate with R\&D to communicate customer requirements, report tool issues, and drive product enhancements based on field deployment feedback
* Work closely with sales, marketing, and field teams to articulate PrimeTime's technical advantages to design teams and engineering management
* Develop and refine TCL\-based automation scripts and methodologies that improve customer productivity and timing closure efficiency
* Support customers through the full design flow, interfacing with synthesis, physical design, extraction, and ECO processes to ensure seamless PrimeTime integration


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Accelerate customer tape\-out schedules by resolving critical timing issues and enabling faster, more confident timing closure
* Expand PrimeTime footprint and deepen usage across customer organizations through technical excellence and trusted advisory relationships
* Influence the PrimeTime product roadmap by translating real\-world customer challenges into actionable R\&D priorities
* Reduce customer risk and rework by delivering training and methodologies that prevent common timing pitfalls before they become schedule killers
* Strengthen Synopsys competitive position by demonstrating measurable performance, capacity, and accuracy advantages in head\-to\-head evaluations
* Enable design teams to adopt advanced timing analysis techniques for process variation, multi\-mode multi\-corner, and signal integrity that improve chip performance and yield
* Build long\-term customer partnerships where Synopsys is seen as an extension of their engineering team, not just a tool vendor


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in ASIC/SoC design, timing analysis, or related fields, or Master's degree with 7\+ years of experience
* Deep working knowledge of Synopsys PrimeTime, including hands\-on experience running STA, analyzing timing reports, and debugging violations in real customer designs
* Solid understanding of timing corners, process variations, on\-chip variation (OCV), advanced OCV (AOCV), statistical STA, and signal integrity effects on timing
* Familiarity with the broader digital design flow, including synthesis, place and route, parasitic extraction, and ECO methodologies
* Strong TCL scripting skills for automation, flow customization, and productivity improvements
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineering teams and management, prior customer\-facing experience is a strong plus
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed for training, support, and technical engagements


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting with a timing report full of violations and walk out with a clear action plan that the design team trusts and can execute
* You know when to push back on a customer request because the real problem is upstream in their methodology, and you know how to have that conversation without burning the relationship
* You are comfortable context\-switching between a competitive benchmark for a prospect, a tape\-out crisis call with an existing customer, and a product enhancement discussion with R\&D, all in the same week
* You treat customer problems like they are your own, not because it is good service, but because you genuinely want to see the design succeed and you know your tool is the reason it will
* You can explain a nuanced timing tradeoff to an engineering director in two sentences without losing the technical accuracy that matters
* You stay current on process technology trends, design challenges, and timing methodologies because you know that what worked at 28nm does not always work at 5nm, and your customers need you to know the difference


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in partner management, business development, management consulting, or corporate sales.
* 4 years of experience within the Indian e\-commerce, digital retail, direct\-to\-consumer, or marketplace ecosystem.
* Experience in initiating, negotiating, structuring, and facilitating commercial agreements and partnerships.
* Experience collaborating with executives (C\-level/VP), and across cross\-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, Operations, Marketing).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Deep knowledge of the India commerce landscape, including consumer tech trends, omnichannel retail, payment ecosystems, and digital infrastructure.
* Proven ability to build data\-driven partnership growth strategies, financial models, and multi\-quarter joint business plans.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across matrixed global organizations.
* Strong product and technical fluency with e\-commerce systems (APIs, catalog integrations, merchant feeds, and order management platforms).


**About The Job**
 As the eCommerce Strategic Partner Manager for Google Store India, you will be responsible for driving commercial growth, business attainment, and market expansion for Google’s first\-party (1P) hardware and services store in India. You will manage direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) sales performance across the Pixel ecosystem (Pixel phones, Pixel Watch, Pixel Buds, Nest, and accessories), designing promotional strategies, optimizing affordability and conversion mechanics (financing, trade\-in/exchange, EMI), and collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders across APAC and global teams.
   

  

 This team will maximize first\-party hardware device and service sales while delivering exceptional eCommerce and retail experiences for customers to discover, purchase, and enjoy Google\-built products. We provide customers with the direct channel to explore and purchase the full ecosystem of Pixel, Nest, Fitbit, and Google subscription services. We also create seamless discovery, trade\-in, financing, onboarding, and customer care experiences, and position the Google Store as the benchmark for how Google hardware, AI, and software work together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead annual and quarterly sales planning, demand forecasting, and operational pipeline reviews.
* Track business KPIs (conversion rate, AOV, attach rate, NPS, return/cancellation rates). Plan and execute commercial campaigns aligned with major local and global retail moments (e.g., New Product Introductions (NPI), Diwali, Google Birthday, summer/holiday sales).
* Structure engaging trade\-in/device exchange programs, bank/EMI financing offers, promotional bundles, channel merchandising and customer experience. Partner with merchandising and site operations to optimize customer journey, product discovery, and pricing parity.
* Coordinate trade\-in valuation mechanics, checkout conversion flows, payment partner integrations, and omnichannel and partner alignment. Coordinate go\-to\-market strategies with third\-party retail and national distributor partners (e.g., Flipkart, Croma) to ensure healthy channel harmony and brand positioning.
* Partner with supply chain, logistics and Merchant of Record (MoR) partners on inventory allocation, order fulfillment, and returns management.

description:
Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced E\-Learning Manager to lead and grow our online learning business in the US market. The role will be responsible for identifying prospective learners, understanding their career and learning requirements, counselling them on suitable courses, Convincing, driving enrolments, and ensuring a smooth onboarding experience.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Identify and approach potential learners in the US market through various channels.
 



 • Understand prospective learners' career goals, interests, and learning requirements.
 



 • Provide counselling and guidance on suitable courses and learning programs.
 



 • Clearly explain course curriculum, benefits, career opportunities, fees, and learning outcomes.
 



 • Convince and influence prospective learners to enrol in relevant courses.
 



 • Conduct regular follow\-ups with learners and maintain strong engagement throughout the decision\-making process.
 



 • Manage the complete learner journey from initial approach, counselling, and conversion to enrolment and onboarding.
 



 • Ensure learners complete the required registration, documentation, payment, and onboarding formalities.
 



 • Build strong relationships with learners and provide support throughout the onboarding process.
 



 • Maintain accurate records of leads, follow\-ups, conversions, enrolments, and learner interactions.
 



 • Track sales and enrolment performance and provide regular updates to management.
 



 • Work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth and positive learner experience.
 



 • Achieve assigned enrolment, conversion, and revenue targets.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in E\-Learning or a related industry.
 



 • Should have strong experience sales, counselling, Convincing , Identifying, communication, and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to engage and convert prospective learners in the US market.
 



 • Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
 



 • Flexible to work for US time zone.

description:

 We are seeking a Principal Presales Solution Architect to lead the design and sales strategy for enterprise hybrid cloud managed services. This role combines deep technical architecture with commercial acumen, cost modeling expertise, and hands\-on proficiency with Gen AI tools. You will design end\-to\-end solutions integrating on\-premises datacenters with public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), author compelling technical proposals, build financial business cases, and influence enterprise deals worth $5–$20M\+. title: Lead AI Solutions Consultant
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution** 




  





 At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work.
 



  





**Why Skan AI** 




  





 We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
 



  





 Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
 



  





 Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
 



  





 AI Solutions is our global post\-sales and professional\-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end\-to\-end. We are AI\-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.
 



  





**The role.** 
 The design authority and quality bar for the team — a functional\-governance role for the most technical, most trusted consultant in the room. You set the solution\-quality bar across the whole team, frame and gate\-review the hardest solutions before they ship, build the industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that scale everyone, and lead from the front, hands\-on, on the toughest work. Additionally, you own your own book of accounts end\-to\-end — these are the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has. You begin to own top\-line and margin alongside delivery leadership. For a seasoned leader from a top consulting firm or SI who wants to build, ship and set the standard, this is the seat.
 



  





**What you own** 



* Full end\-to\-end ownership of your own book — the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has (across industries such as BFSI and healthcare), owned from discovery to realized value.
* Design authority and the solution\-quality bar across the team — you frame the hardest problems and gate\-review solutions before they ship.
* Industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
* Leading from the front — hands\-on where the solution stretches beyond out\-of\-the\-box — and coaching the Seniors.
* Top\-line and margin awareness — beginning to own the delivery\-leadership economics alongside delivery leadership.



**What we look for** 



* 8\+ years with deep, demonstrable end\-to\-end delivery leadership on strategic accounts; top consulting\-firm / SI leaders who now build and ship, not just advise.
* Principal\-level technical depth and architecture judgment — sets standards, builds playbooks, raises the bar for others.
* Industry depth (BFSI, healthcare or similar) and the ability to build reusable, industry\-specific assets.
* Commercial awareness — comfortable reasoning about utilization, top\-line and margin.
* Solutions\-led leader who leads by example; heavily hands\-on at the highest bar.



**The persona \& bar** 



* **Thrives in uncertainty:** 
 Can run a substantive, back\-and\-forth customer conversation, build on a fuzzy idea, and convert uncertainty into certainty — Idea → Implementation → Impact. Customers are under pressure and want someone who guides and coaches them.
* **Pragmatic solutioning:** 
 Navigates roadblocks and imperfect systems without waiting to be told what to do — independent judgment over guidance\-dependence.
* **Data\-first, value\-driven (not task execution):** 
 The real work isn't just executing the task in front of you. You own the step before — figuring out what data matters to create foresight on what to optimize — and the step after — the 'what next' that turns insight into value — keeping everything aligned to the customer's bigger goals.
* **AI\-first by default:** 
 Collects data first, then builds agents to optimize workflows — moving past large, manual analyst\-and\-developer teams.
* **Ownership, agility, client\-facing:** 
 Continuous contact with the customer and heavy ownership across every one of these dimensions.



**How the role works** 



* **Our priorities, in order:** 
 product expert (trained and certified on Skan), AI\-first (agents do the repeat work — every consultant a 10x consultant), solutions\-led (solve the true business problem), and end\-to\-end ownership from discovery through adoption.
* **The bar:** 
 you solve real customer problems, and you independently lead a customer discovery session — turning discovery and ideas into a clear plan to ship and adopt an AI solution.
* **Hands\-on and technical:**

**About The Role**
 As a Domain Strategist – Life Sciences, you will make an impact by crafting compelling, insight\-led proposals and bid responses for life sciences clients across the pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics sectors. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Business Development team and work collaboratively with Sales and Solutioning teams to map client needs to solution capabilities and communicate clear business value to clients and key stakeholders.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to prospective customers in the US market. You will own the technical evaluation journey end\-to\-end, from the first discovery call to closing the deal, by demonstrating how our platform solves real\-world data integration challenges. This role involves working closely with global customers (primarily North America ), designing scalable architectures, running tailored product demos, and building proofs\-of\-concept that showcase value.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end\-to\-end.
* Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e. g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4 Snowflake, dbt).
* Run live product demos tailored to the customer's stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
* Own the technical evaluation from the first conversation to the closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
* Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.
* Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience as a Data engineer, Analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or Data warehouse engineer.
* Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.
* Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
* Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* This is non\-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo's technical capability to a global customer base. That means:
* Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience.
* You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls.
* You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.
* You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation.
* You have presented or demoed something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.
* Genuine interest in customer\-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline and integration tools.
* Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions.
* Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders or analytics teams or working with international teams across time zones.

title: Senior Presales
description:
**BCITS PRIVATE LIMITED** 




**Powering Utility Digitalization Since 1999** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




 Presales – Utility Solutions (AMI, Metering, Billing \& Revenue Management)
 



**Department:** 
 Presales \& Business Development
 



**Function:** 
 RFP Analysis, Deliverable Mapping \& Internal Cost Estimation
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Executive Officer
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka (travel for pre\-bid meetings and site visits as required)
 



**Industry Domain:** 
 Power, Water \& Gas Utilities AMI, Smart Metering, MDAS/MDM, Billing \& Revenue Management
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**ABOUT BCITS** 




 BCITS Private Limited, incorporated in 1999 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a technology partner to the power, water and gas utility sector. Over 25 years, BCITS has delivered more than 100 projects across India as an OEM and system integrator in Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Meter Data Acquisition, Revenue \& Billing Management, Meter Data Management, CIS, CRM, GIS and Smart/Spot Metering solutions.
 



 Empaneled by the Power Finance Corporation (PFC) as a Meter Data Acquisition Solution Provider under R\-APDRP, BCITS works with state distribution utilities and large System Integrators/EPCs (AMISPs) on turnkey programs that reduce losses, improve revenue and enhance customer service. BCITS is strengthening its presales function to bid accurately and competitively across AMI, RDSS and digital utility transformation programs.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




 Every bid BCITS submits rests on one internal document: the cost sheet. It converts the RFP's scope, deliverables, SLAs and contract terms into every rupee BCITS will spend to execute the project. If the sheet misses a cost, BCITS wins the bid and loses money. If it overstates cost, BCITS prices itself out and does not win. This role owns that sheet.
 



 This is a domain\-first estimation role, not a generalist bid\-coordination or proposal\-writing role. We are looking for someone who has worked inside utility metering, billing or AMI projects, can read an RFP the way a delivery head reads it, and can independently produce a complete, defensible cost workbook that leadership can price from with confidence.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 Own the translation of utility RFPs/tenders into:
 



**(a)** 
 a clear, itemised list of what BCITS must deliver
 



**(b)** 
 a complete internal Excel cost model covering every component and expenditure BCITS will incur across the full contract term with no omissions, no double\-counting and no padding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. RFP / Tender Comprehension
 


* Read the entire tender pack scope of work, technical specifications, SLAs, payment terms, GCC/SCC, annexures, corrigenda and pre\-bid clarifications and extract precisely what BCITS is obligated to deliver, supply, install, integrate, operate and maintain, and for how long.
* Distinguish explicit deliverables from implied ones (e.g., a data\-migration obligation hidden in an integration clause, a training obligation inside a go\-live milestone, a DR requirement inside an uptime SLA).
* Identify eligibility, compliance and technical conditions that affect cost or bid fit (certifications, MeitY cloud, BIS/IS standards, local\-content rules, consortium terms).
* Flag ambiguities, contradictions and scope gaps and draft pre\-bid queries whose answers directly change the cost model.



 2\. Deliverable Mapping
 


* Prepare a Deliverable Breakdown Structure for each bid: every item BCITS must deliver, the quantity, the specification, the phase/milestone in which it falls and the acceptance condition.
* Validate the breakdown with delivery, solution and O\&M leads so that nothing in the RFP is left unowned internally.



 3\. Internal Cost Estimation (core accountability)
 


* Build the internal cost workbook in Excel for each bid, itemised across the cost heads listed below, with quantities, unit rates, sources of rates, assumptions and the calculation logic visible and auditable.
* Model costs across the full contract life implementation, warranty, O\&M/AMC including escalation, replacement cycles, SLA penalty exposure and cash\-flow impact of milestone\-linked payments.
* Obtain and validate rates from OEMs, telecom/communication partners, cloud providers, subcontractors and internal delivery teams; maintain a current rate library so estimates are not built from stale figures.
* Run sensitivity and scenario views (consumer count, read frequency, hosting model, manpower mix) so leadership can see where the estimate is most exposed.
* Present the cost sheet to the CEO and bid committee with a clear statement of assumptions, risks and confidence level; support margin and pricing decisions with facts, not opinions.



 4\. Bid Support
 


* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site visits; capture clarifications and corrigenda and reflect their cost impact immediately in the workbook.
* Support commercial bid preparation (BOQ/price schedule) so that the submitted price schedule reconciles exactly with the internal cost model.
* Support post\-submission clarifications, negotiations and reverse\-auction rounds with a clear view of the floor price.



 5\. Estimation Discipline \& Learning Loop
 


* Maintain a standard cost\-sheet template and estimation checklist for AMI/metering/billing bids and improve it after every bid.
* Compare estimated vs actual cost on won projects with delivery and finance teams; feed variances back into the template and rate library.
* Maintain a tender tracker with bid outcomes, L1 pricing intelligence and win/loss reasons.



  





**COST HEADS THE ROLE MUST COVER** 




 The candidate should be able to identify, size and price the following from an RFP without being prompted:
 



**Software \& Licences** 




 HES, MDM/MDAS, billing/CIS, CRM, GIS, prepaid, analytics, mobile apps; third\-party licences (DB, OS, middleware, cloud); customisation and integration effort with utility legacy systems.
 



**Hardware \& Field Devices** 




 Meters, communication modules, DCUs/gateways/RF concentrators, network equipment; spares, DOA/warranty replacement, testing and lab charges.
 



**Communication \& Connectivity** 




 RF mesh / RF\-PLC / NB\-IoT / cellular; SIM and data charges over contract life; telecom partner terms.
 



**Infrastructure \& Hosting** 




 Data centre / cloud (on\-prem vs MeitY\-empanelled cloud), DR, sizing for consumer count and read frequency, bandwidth, security compliance, escalation over term.
 



**Manpower** 




 Project management, solution and integration teams, field survey, installation and commissioning crews, helpdesk, O\&M staff — by role, location, duration and rate, including deployment ramp\-up/ramp\-down.
 



**Installation \& Commissioning** 




 Site survey, meter installation and replacement, testing, consumer indexing, data migration, UAT, go\-live support, training.
 



**O\&M / AMC / FMS** 




 Multi\-year operations, SLA\-linked penalties and liquidated damages, annual price escalation, obsolescence and technology refresh.
 



**Commercial \& Compliance** 




 EMD, PBG/security deposit cost, insurance, taxes/GST treatment, payment\-milestone cash flow and working\-capital cost, retention money, price\-variation clauses.
 



**Risk \& Contingency** 




 Quantified contingency for scope ambiguity, exchange rate, delayed site readiness, AMISP/SI consortium dependencies and change\-request exposure.
 



  





**MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS** 



* **Domain** 
 Hands\-on utility domain experience: 6–12 years in the power/water/gas utility sector in AMI, smart metering, MDAS/MDM, billing/revenue management or metering\-communication projects in a delivery, solution, project\-management, estimation or presales capacity. Candidates without direct utility\-domain exposure will not be considered.
* **RFP literacy** 
 Has read and worked from utility RFPs/tenders (DISCOM, AMISP, SI/EPC, RDSS, R\-APDRP, IPDS, SMNP) and can explain scope, SLAs, payment milestones and penalty clauses in operational terms.
* **Costing track record** 
 Has personally built or owned bottom\-up cost estimates / BOQs for multi\-component technology projects with software, hardware, manpower and multi\-year O\&M elements; can show a sample or walk through one in interview.
* **Excel** 
 Advanced Excel structured, auditable workbooks with clear assumptions, lookups, scenario tabs and reconciliation checks. This is the primary working tool of the role.
* **Delivery realism** 
 Understands the practical cost drivers of an AMI/metering rollout where projects overrun (site readiness, communication coverage, consumer indexing, integration with legacy billing, O\&M manpower) and how those translate to money.
* **Attention to detail** 
 Demonstrated habit of checking work line by line, reconciling totals and questioning numbers that look wrong. Comfortable being accountable for the accuracy of the estimate.
* **Education** 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Computer Science) or equivalent.



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* MBA (Finance/Operations) or formal exposure to project costing, cost accounting or financial modelling.
* Working relationships with meter OEMs, communication technology providers, cloud/hosting partners or AMISPs.

**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.

* Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with senior UK stakeholders, including Partners, Directors and Pursuit Leaders. (Essential)
* Prior experience in deals/pre\-sales/bid management and project management
* Experience supporting complex proposals, bids or pursuit opportunities in a professional services environment
* Good business acumen and understanding of business development, Deal/ project management and coordination skills
* Strong digital toolkit skills including Microsoft 365, AI\-enabled tools and advanced online research techniques
* Experience with SharePoint is desirable
* Able to build collaborative relationships with a variety of stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**
* University/bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s in business administration


**Experience:**
* 5 years to 8 years
* Minimum 3 years' experience working within a large global organisation, preferably within a professional services environment
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent written and spoken English is essential. The role involves daily interaction with UK\-based stakeholders and requires the ability to participate confidently in meetings, manage communications independently and produce high\-quality written outputs


**Certification Requirements:**
* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum
* APMP certification, PMP certification or equivalent bid/project management qualification would be advantageous


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Previous experience working directly with UK clients or UK stakeholder teams would be highly advantageous.
* As the job involves responding to clients’ needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel – for attending leadership meetings/trainings


**Technologies and Tools**
* Excellent Microsoft 365 skills including Copilot, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Skill specifications
   

  

 The candidate is encouraged to have a deep understanding of core IP networking concepts (TCP/IP, QoS, VLAN, STP, IPSEC, NAT, IPv6\). Should possess reasonable expertise in Layer2, Layer3 protocols such as VRRP, OSPF, BGP, Multicast, MPLS VPN.

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Founder's Office \- Strategy \& Operations** 





 LH2 AI Labs · Bengaluru · Full\-time · On\-site 
 




  





**Mandatory requirement: a bachelor's degree from a premier engineering institute such as IIT, BITS, or NIT, or an MBA from a leading business school such as IIM, ISB, XLRI, or an equivalent institution.** 




  





**About** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2\.ai) is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on – there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we envision creating a world where frontier models can access data on tap – exactly how they access compute today.
 




  





**The role** 





 We're looking for smart people to lead our revenue function – i.e., our data verticals – coding, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, and many upcoming verticals.
 





 Leading a vertical means an ownership mindset and owning the entire revenue stack:
 



* Working with frontier models to understand training data requirements
* Finding the right data owners
* Negotiating licensing rights and closing agreements
* Building the delivery data pipelines with our engineering team
* Ensuring seamless delivery




 This is not a role where you'll be making decks or Excel sheets. It's a carry\-a\-number, close\-the\-deal role that happens to sit right next to the founders.
 





 Here's how it works. We point you at a vertical – codebases, medical, audio, whatever's next – and you go build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You own the whole thing: who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. Each vertical runs like its own small business, and what you learn in the field shapes what the founders prioritise next.
 





 We can teach you the domain, the data, and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want closure. That part you bring.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 



* You can sell. 2\-5 years in sales, partnerships, or BD with a real sales cycle – ideally opening and building new relationships from scratch (new business / new logo, not just managing an existing book). You've carried a number and owned deals end to end.
* Genuinely sharp. Top\-tier education and/or time at well\-regarded companies – you've operated around a high bar, and it shows. You pick things up fast, and you can hold your own in a room.
* Consultative problem\-solver – you read what a counterpart needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* Think like an owner – comfortable shaping how your vertical goes to market, not just executing a plan handed to you.
* Comfortable negotiating bespoke, non\-standard terms.
* Sharp on quality: you can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* High ownership; thrive in fast, ambiguous environments.
* A generalist who has worked in startups before – hands\-on with tools, automation, and basic scripting, and comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.



  





**Bonus** 



* Prior experience in a programme management role.
* Opened new markets, categories, or accounts from cold – where the relationship didn't exist before you walked in.
* A track record of running many deals at once, against a target, without hand\-holding.
* Sold into small buying committees (fewer than five stakeholders) and know how to move them.
* Prior exposure to AI, data, expert networks, or marketplaces.
* Founder's office, consulting, banking, or operating roles at a high\-growth B2B company.
