description:
**About the Company** 




 Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet. As a member of our team, you’ll dive into an environment that encourages learning and boundary\-pushing every day. You’ll be part of an agile and dynamic workplace where today’s solutions are built for tomorrow’s challenges.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Industrial Applications Engineer – Energy \& Decarbonization is a globally\-scoped, customer\-facing technical role that can be based in India, UK, or China. The role serves Armstrong’s Industrial business across Metals, Mining, Cement, Food \& Beverage, and other power and water\-intensive industries. This role is the founding layer of Armstrong’s Industrial Regional Sales Enablement Centre (RSEC) function. The person in this position receives strategic direction from the Global Product Manager, translates it into commercial and technical enablement for regional sales teams, and feeds ground\-level customer and market intelligence back to shape how that strategy evolves. The core technical mandate is built on four pillars: Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure Applications – covering descaling, high pressure washing and cleaning, and high\-pressure fluid supply systems for hydraulic press operations. The primary mission is simple but demanding ensure that every industrial offer submitted is technically sound and commercially compelling, and that Armstrong’s value proposition is consistently understood and communicated by the regional sales teams that carry it to market.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Offer Creation \& Technical Quality** 



* This is the primary accountability of the role. The Industrial Applications Engineer owns the creation and quality of every technical offer submitted in the industrial segment.
* Own the end\-to\-end creation of technical offers for industrial customers across Metals, Mining, Cement, Food \& Beverage, and other power and water\-intensive sectors.
* Ensure every offer is technically accurate, application\-appropriate, and clearly communicates the Armstrong value proposition in language that resonates with industrial plant\-level stakeholders.
* Select and specify the right solution architecture across Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure Applications based on customer process requirements.
* Build energy savings calculations, ROI models, and lifecycle cost cases from first principles as the commercial backbone of each offer.
* Conduct detailed P\&ID analysis for each customer engagement – mapping every heating, cooling, water transfer, and high\-pressure touchpoint to identify the full Armstrong addressable scope and ensure offers reflect the complete opportunity, not just the immediate enquiry.
* Ensure offers reflect industrial environment requirements including protection classes, IP ratings, and hazardous area classifications appropriate to the application.
* Review and validate offers prepared by the regional sales team before submission, maintaining a consistent technical and commercial quality standard across all industrial proposals.



  





**Customer Technical Engagement** 



* The Industrial Applications Engineer is the technical authority in customer\-facing industrial conversations, supporting and enabling the regional sales teams who own the customer relationship.
* Engage directly with plant engineers, process managers, and energy managers at customer facilities to understand process requirements, pain points, and optimization opportunities.
* Conduct site assessments and process audits to map Heating, Cooling, Water Transfer, and High\-Pressure system architectures and identify where Armstrong solutions deliver value.
* Analyse P\&IDs as a commercial tool – identifying every relevant application touchpoint across the plant to build a structured opportunity map that maximises Armstrong wallet share at each account.
* Deliver technically credible presentations and solution walkthroughs that translate complex fluid\-flow and thermal management concepts into clear operational and financial outcomes for the customer.
* Support customers in understanding how Armstrong solutions meet industrial environment requirements, protection class standards, and process\-specific compliance needs.



  





**Industrial Strategy Propagation \& Sales Enablement** 



* A core responsibility of this role is to ensure that Armstrong’s industrial strategy is understood, adopted, and consistently executed by regional sales teams – preventing the default tendency to revert to commodity product selling.
* Receive and internalise Armstrong’s industrial strategy from the Global Product Manager and translate it into actionable guidance, tools, and training for regional sales teams.
* Train regional sales teams on Armstrong’s industrial offer, application scope, value proposition, energy savings methodology, ROI narrative, and decarbonization positioning.
* Develop and maintain repeatable sales enablement tools – application guides, value proposition frameworks, calculation templates, and reference case studies – that raise the technical floor of commercial teams globally.
* Actively participate in regional weekly sales reviews, contributing industrial application expertise, offer quality oversight, and strategic direction to ensure industrial opportunities are being pursued with the right solution and the right narrative.
* Monitor CRM pipeline in collaboration with sales to ensure industrial opportunities are properly qualified, accurately described, and progressing with the correct Armstrong solution – flagging where commodity positioning is replacing solution selling.
* Feed ground\-level market and customer intelligence back to the Global Product Manager to continuously refine and sharpen Armstrong’s industrial strategy based on real commercial experience.



  





**High Pressure Applications** 



* High Pressure Applications represent a distinct and technically demanding segment within Armstrong’s industrial portfolio. The Industrial Applications Engineer is the subject matter authority for this space.
* Define and deliver application solutions for high pressure fluid supply systems powering hydraulic press circuits in metals and heavy manufacturing environments.
* Develop application expertise in high pressure descaling systems – including billet, slab, and strip mill descaling in steel and aluminium production.
* Build competency in high pressure washing and cleaning system applications for industrial and hygiene\-critical environments including Food \& Beverage.
* Advise on system design, pressure management, equipment selection, and safety considerations for high pressure circuits operating in industrial protection class environments.
* Ensure high pressure application requirements are accurately captured and specified in customer offers.



  





**Energy Optimization \& Decarbonization Positioning** 



* Energy savings and decarbonization are the strategic lens through which Armstrong’s industrial value proposition is delivered – not a separate workstream, but the narrative frame applied across all customer and sales engagements.
* Quantify energy savings and carbon reduction potential of Armstrong

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R286
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect part of a the Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI\-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long\-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You will help our customers achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Consulting Architect - Search
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud\-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
   

  

**What is The Role:**
 We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
 **Consulting Architect** 
 to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands\-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
   

  

 You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value\-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior\-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on\-site client engagement.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing:**
 As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on\-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end\-to\-end delivery of ground\-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof\-of\-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
   

  

 Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
   

  

 Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
   

  

**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**
* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7\+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine\-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience with on\-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands\-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship\-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for a Professional Services Consultant to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Bangalore) role, reporting to the Sr Manager, Professional Services, SecOps in the Professional Services department. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor for enterprise customers, helping design, deploy, and optimize security solutions across complex network and security environments. You will work closely with customers to strengthen their security posture, improve operational resilience, and enable secure transformation across cloud, hybrid, and modern enterprise infrastructures. title: Lead - Managed Services Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What Are Your Responsibilities**
* Ensure that every customer derives the most value possible from the platform leading to retention and business expansion.
* Identify, comprehend and clearly articulate customers' requirements to generate an end\-to\-end solution to their business challenges.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and tie them to specific Sprinklr use cases, product features, benefits and value propositions.
* Identify platform gaps, and optimization opportunities; designing and configuring the appropriate solutions so client expectations regarding platform use\-cases and functionalities are fulfilled.
* Own \& deliver the end\-to\-end configuration of solution based on the customer requirements
* You will handle the post go\-live change management of configuration throughout the customer life cycle
* Be the hands\-on product expert and ensure customer’s business goals are met
* Act as day\-to\-day contact for stakeholders in brand, agencies and for System Administrators.
* Analyse and elevate customer’s consumption of contract, adoption of the product and generation of upsell or cross\-sell.
* Provide oversight on any additional enablement of the software deployment to be in line with current architecture and future client needs or business requirements.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve operational efficiencies and find suitable entities which could benefit from utilising AI to drive greater ROI.
* Establish and nurture senior level relationships built on trust, develop client champions and identify key stakeholders.
* Capture development areas for product improvement and collaborate with product managers and engineering for necessary corrective actions.
* Actively make sure you are knowledgeable on native channel’s products package.
* Work with clients to improve the social service itself and its alignment with the client's core business.
* Provide on\-going training support and ad hoc training sessions to always keep customers educated on Sprinklr’s know\-hows.
* Identify opportunities for customer references and case studies.
* Maintain platform relevancy according to changes in business needs.


- 

**Who You Are \& What Makes You Qualified**
**Must Have Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years of experience in managed services or technology consulting, specifically in the CCaaS or cloud contact center industry.
* Strong knowledge of CCaaS technologies, including IVR, call routing, AI integrations, and customer journey management.
* Experience with cloud communication platforms, AI\-driven customer support solutions, Chatbots and integrating CCaaS with third\-party applications.
* Familiarity with CCaaS platforms like Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or other related technologies.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, VoIP, SIP, and telephony.
* Hands\-on experience with system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with clients and internal teams.
* Proven ability to understand business challenges and provide actionable recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements and deliver high\-quality service.
* Ability to translate customer business problems \& requirements into on platform solutions


**Good to Have Skills:**
* Demonstrated experience and a passion for the social technology universe (i.e., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok).
* Direct experience in working with a social media management software is preferred.
* Strong product acumen \& evangelization experience with the aptitude to learn new products.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Multilingual skills (French, German, Spanish, Japanese or others) would be a plus.
* Analytical mind\-set with attention to detail along with excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Leading CCaaS Certifications like Genesys Cloud CX Professional, Cisco Certified Professional, Avaya Certified IC are preferred (not mandatory)


**Who You Are**
 You are a technology consultant who has the:
   

  

* Ability to think independently and learn as a member of a team.
* Ability to identify and clearly articulate issues clients are facing and capability of devising \& implementing their solutions.
* Ability to work in a highly challenging \& competitive environment while delivering high quality of customer service.
* Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and juggle several assignments \& projects simultaneously, while maintaining high standard of excellence.
* Intrinsically motivated to tackle unique client use cases, passion to solve business challenges and commitment to client delight.
* Ability to interpret industry trends across different verticals \& lines of businesses.
* Ability to operate in an autonomous way, engage with stakeholders across the globe and lead customers through change management.


**You Know You're Successful If**
* The depth, breadth and frequency of customer platform adoption starts strong and keeps climbing.
* Your customers acknowledge Sprinklr value, renew their product offerings \& add new licences, modules and services to their package.
* You constantly come up with new strategies that are adopted by your clients and peers.
* Your stakeholders participate in Sprinklr events, references and case studies.
* Your platform and industry knowledge makes you a trusted advisor both internally and externally.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world\-class candidates to join our–FSI Fintech business.
   

  

 As a Fintech Account Leader for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase adoption, and market penetration in large Fintech accounts to build long\-term business and marketing opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess a business development/sales background that enables them to engage at all levels of a customer and partner organization, including C\-levels of the business and Tech. You should be a self\-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan business objectives. This is a high visibility role needing to engage CXOs of Fintechs as well as leverage internal executives to drive transformational outcomes for large Fintechs in the long term.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with the C\-levels of Business \& Tech for the given Accounts.
* Work closely with the Channels team to ensure that AWS India is the partner's preferred cloud computing platform across all service lines.
* Maintain an accurate forecast and various business reports.
* Create \& articulate compelling value propositions around AWS Cloud Offerings and AI offerings
* Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, GenAI and Agentic AI, Infrastructure solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) \& Internet architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc)
* Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
* Ensure customer satisfaction


 A day in the life
   

  

 Research on the FSI Fintech domain and preparation for the day’s customers meetings and calls. Collaborate with Cross functional teams on pitches and solution demos for,
   

  

 Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls
   

  

 Stakeholder mapping
   

  

 Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene
   

  

 Ensure timely communication with External and Internal stakeholders
   

  

**About The Team**
 This team is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from enterprise\-level FSI customers. The team interacts with leading FSI and Fintech companies and believes that world\-class support is critical to customer success. AWS also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission\-critical applications on top of AWS services.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Associate, Startup Accounts
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role** 
**: Associate,** 
**Startup Accounts Farming**
 To sustain and nurture solid relationships with key clients that generate the most income for Razorpay.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Building and maintaining relationships with clients and key personnel within their company.
* Cross\-selling and Up\-selling to the client base and growing the account to achieve the portfolio quota.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

description:
Location: Mumbai / Bengaluru only
   

  

 Type: Full\-time \| Reports to: Founder / VP Product GTM \| Start: Immediate
   

  

**ANY APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE PREREQUISITE DELIVERABLES MENTIONED IN THE “HOW TO APPLY” SECTION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**
**About CredServ**
 CredServ is building the operating layer for financial relationships between businesses — an AI\-native platform built for how companies trade, monitor exposure, collect cash, and reconcile.
   

  

**Live Products Today**
* CredCheck — who to do business with, how much exposure to take, how to monitor the relationship.
* CredCollect — an AI conversation agent that follows up on invoices and gets businesses paid faster, with a human in the loop.


 Downstream: CredRecon. The long game is a global business\-relationship graph. Every customer is a node. Every distributor, dealer, and invoice is an edge.
   

  

 We acquire three compounding cohorts: corporates who sell through dealers; SMB / MSME distributors and dealers; and independent last\-mile businesses who collect from customers. Each cohort has a different product surface. Mixing them is how conversion dies. Read more about what we do: credserv.ai
   

  

**The role**
 We need an execution\-first Product GTM Manager who will own revenue quality and unit economics from week one — and who treats AI agents as staff, not as a slide topic.
   

  

 This is not a brand job. This is not a ‘give me a performance\-marketing budget and a team’ job. Paid social already exists for SMB and micro\-business acquisition. Corporate acquisitions are named\-account work, LinkedIn, and live working sessions. A Grok agent desk already drafts research, iteration, and execution. You will run that desk, sit with customers, force the smallest product changes that move conversion, and be accountable for rupees in versus rupees out.
   

  

 If your instinct is to scale spend before activation is understood, this seat will feel underpowered. That is intentional.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* A weekly number: corporate pilots closed, SMB/distributor organisations that reach a first value event, and last\-mile users who collect a first rupee — not pipeline coverage or MQL volume.
* Unit economics by cohort: cost to a working session (corporate), cost to activation (SMB), cost to first reminder and first collection (micro). Floors are published. Breaching them to buy volume is a miss.
* The daily loop: execute → measure → kill what does not work → specify a product micro\-fix → ship → execute again.
* Corporate motion: named accounts, insight\-led LinkedIn, 20\-minute working sessions (hear the agent on real overdue rows), 14\-day DSO\-sprint pilots, and invites that pull the corporate’s dealers onto CredServ.
* SMB and micro motion: hold existing Instagram / Facebook / YouTube / WhatsApp and on\-ground UGC / affiliate channels to activation and cash — reallocate every day. Do not ‘run the campaign’.
* Direct the existing AI agents (research, iteration, execution). Improve their prompts and playbooks. Do not replace them with a meeting culture.
* Write one\-page product patch specs (example: GSTIN\-first signup, WhatsApp three\-name collect list, shareable agent recording, dealer\-invite claim). Sit with engineering until the patch is live.
* A daily numbers note and a weekly review. Short. No committee decks.


**What You Will Not Own**
* A blank media cheque or a six\-person demand\-gen org in quarter one.
* Making paid social the primary way we reach CFOs.
* Brand campaigns, generic webinars, or ‘category design’ as the job.
* A 90\-day listening tour before touching a customer.


**What This Looks Like In 90 Days**
* You have personally run corporate working sessions and taken at least one pilot to a convert\-or\-kill decision, with dealer invites actually sent.
* SMB activation and first\-value\-event rates have moved because a step was deleted or a journey was tightened — not only because more ads were bought.
* At least one product change you specified is live and visible in conversion.
* Unit\-economic floors have held for four straight weeks, or you have formally changed a floor with evidence.
* You can run the daily desk — including the AI agents — without the founder in the room.


**Who This Is For**
 You have carried a number in a messy B2B motion — credit, collections, channel / distribution software, ERP\-adjacent products, invoice / trade finance, MSME infrastructure — and you can open the spreadsheet, not just the narrative.
   

  

**You Have Done Some Mix Of The Following**
* Taken a motion from founder\-led selling to a thin, repeatable machine.
* Improved a funnel by removing steps, not by buying more traffic.
* Sat across the table from a CFO or a proprietor, heard no, and still closed or cleanly killed.
* Used AI agents as colleagues this month — concrete workflows, not ‘we are exploring GenAI’.
* Worked India: English and Hindi. A regional language is an advantage. You will travel for customer dinners and shop\-floor / godown conversations.


 You do not need to have run a 50\-person growth team. You do need to have been responsible when the week missed.
   

  

**Who This Is Not For**
* Operators who are not working in an AI native work environment.
* Operators who do not delegate \>50% of their BAU to AI agents.
* Marketers whose primary proof is ‘we scaled spend 10x’.
* Strategy consultants who have never owned a revenue target after leaving the firm.
* Operators who need a large team and a media tranche before they will touch a customer.
* People who treat WhatsApp\-led or last\-mile motions as beneath them.


**How To Apply**
 Send a short note (one page, not a manifesto) to vivek.kothari@credserv.in, or apply through the board, with the following:
   

  

* A motion you owned where spends went down and revenue quality went up. What did you cut?
* CAC / payback on that motion, and one metric you refused to optimise.
* How you use AI in your work this month — tools, prompts, or agents, not a point of view.
* What you would do in week one at CredServ with no new paid\-media budget, across a corporate buyer and a WhatsApp\-led SMB buyer.


 The subject title of your email must contain
 **\[PRODUCT GTM MANAGER – CSJR0025]** 
 .
   

  

**ANY APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE ABOVE PREREQUISITE DELIVERABLES WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**
 Do not apply if you do not work in a native AI environment / are not at a stage where you delegate \>50% of your BAU to AI. This is a high performance role that requires you to leverage AI to its fullest potential.
   

  

 Candidates who progress will complete a six\-hour case before any offer. We hire on the work, not on the performance of the interview.
   

  

*CredServ is an equal\-opportunity employer. We care that you can run the desk.*

description:
**Job Description**
 Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: \[Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry\-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end\-to\-end across LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi\-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end target\-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi\-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program\-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security \& Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro\-segmentation, and identity\-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI \& Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on\-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site\-to\-site, and remote\-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end\-to\-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud \& Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on\-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch \& Site Modernization
* Architect branch network modernization for our global manufacturing and distribution footprint, including SD\-WAN and Zero Trust Branch patterns.
* Improve user experience, application access, and operational simplicity at sites by reducing dependence on centralized backhaul.
* Define site reference designs that scale across geographies and plant types. Leadership \& Influence
* Mentor staff and senior engineers; raise the technical bar across the networking discipline.
* Partner with vendors and strategic technology partners on evaluations, proofs of concept, and roadmap alignment.
* Translate complex technical trade\-offs into clear, business\-relevant recommendations for senior leadership.
* Maintain authoritative network documentation — reference designs, topology diagrams, and standards — that the broader engineering organization can rely on. What you’ll need to be successful Must\-haves
* 10\+ years of network engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in an architecture role at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining enterprise reference architectures and standards adopted across a multi\-site organization.
* Deep expertise across enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF), segmentation, WAN, SD\-WAN, and wireless.
* Strong network security architecture experience with platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass.
* Strong Azure networking experience, including VNet design, peering, private connectivity, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Experience with DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), IP schema design, and core service resiliency.
* Proven experience architecting Zero Trust Branch, micro\-segmentation, or identity aware network access.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to work across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments in a global, distributed enterprise.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues clearly for both engineering and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement capabilities at the Director and VP level. Nice\-to\-haves
* Experience in manufacturing, CPG, or other industrial environments with significant OT/IT convergence considerations.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCDE, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or TOGAF.
* Experience leading vendor evaluations and architecture proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with network automation, infrastructure as code, and enterprise observability platforms. Our Total Rewards philosophy Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values. Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance\-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents. The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future — we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Travel: Up to 10–15%, as needed.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre\-sales leadership, and practice development.
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


 \#\# Required Qualifications
   

  

 \#\#\# Technical Expertise
   

  

* \*\*10\+ years\*\* of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3\+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM\-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi\-region, multi\-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000\+ concurrent contacts


 \#\#\# Consulting \& Leadership
   

  

* \*\*Pre\-sales experience\*\* — led or co\-led 5\+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end\-to\-end delivery on engagements with 5\+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go\-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C\-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real\-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M\+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go\-live
* Build production\-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third\-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI\-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex\-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real\-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre\-Sales Leadership (10%)

* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C\-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M\+
* Shape deal strategy define technical win themes, competitive positioning, and phased delivery approaches that de\-risk customer commitments

 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

**Role Purpose:\-**
 The Life \& Pension PreSales Manager is a specialist role within Sapiens’ Insurance Practice, responsible for supporting the preparation and delivery of compelling, tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for Life \& Pension (L\&P). Working closely with regional Sales teams and the broader Insurance Practice, this role plays a critical part in driving new business acquisition across APAC by translating prospect requirements into powerful platform demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:\-**
**Demo Preparation \& Delivery**
* Lead the preparation and delivery of tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for L\&P to prospective clients across APAC.
* Configure the CoreSuite demo and presales environment to reflect individual prospect requirements and use cases, including product types (life, pension, annuity, protection).
* Develop and maintain scenario\-based demonstration scripts aligned to common L\&P market challenges and buyer personas.
* Support Proof\-of\-Concept (POC) engagements, including scoping, configuration, delivery, and documentation of outcomes.
* Ensure demo environments are current, stable, and reflect the latest product releases; coordinate with R\&D and Product teams on environment readiness.


**Bid \& RFx Support**
* Collaborate with Sales, Insurance Practice, and R\&D to produce high\-quality, differentiated bid responses within required timelines.


**Solution Architecture \& Discovery**
* Participate in and support Discovery and Blueprint engagements, helping to define the scope of the Sapiens solution to meet prospective or existing customer needs.
* Define and document proposed solution architectures for L\&P prospects, incorporating the Sapiens Life Platform, CoreSuite, and relevant ecosystem components.
* Support the estimation process for commercial scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically feasible and commercially sound.
* Provide input into product solutions designed to meet specific market or regulatory requirements, working collaboratively with R\&D and Insurance Practice colleagues.


**Sales Enablement \& Regional Alignment**
* Act as the presales technical resource for L\&P opportunities across assigned regions, partnering closely with regional Sales Managers and Account Executives.
* Support regional sales alignment by attending and contributing to pipeline reviews, opportunity qualification, and customer\-facing engagements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of presales assets, including demo scripts, use case libraries, capability matrices, and standard presentation materials.
* Provide internal guidance and training to Sales colleagues on L\&P product capability and demonstration best practices.


**Proposition \& Product Input**
* Provide structured feedback from prospect and customer interactions to inform the product roadmap and R\&D prioritisation.
* Participate in design reviews and approval processes for new R\&D roadmap developments relevant to the L\&P market.
* Collaborate with the Insurance Practice and Product teams to define functional capabilities required to support the strategic direction of the Sapiens L\&P proposition.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience:\-**
**Essential**
* Demonstrable experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within the insurance software or insurtech sector.
* Strong working knowledge of Life \& Pension insurance products, operations, and technology platforms – including policy administration systems (PAS).
* Proven ability to configure, prepare, and deliver high\-quality software demonstrations to senior insurance executives.
* Demonstrate ability to leverage AI tools and platforms to develop and articulate compelling value propositions for AI\-driven strategies within life insurance administration solutions, translating complex capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting RFI/RFP processes.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; confident engaging with C\-suite, business, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, structured solution narratives.
* Self\-motivated, organised, and able to manage multiple concurrent presales engagements.


**Desirable**
* Experience in working in a Life and Pensions Insurer, possibly in an operational capacity.
* Hands\-on experience with Sapiens CoreSuite for L\&P or Sapiens Life Platform.
* Familiarity with insurance regulatory frameworks across EMEA and APAC markets.
* Experience working within a global or matrix organisation.
* Exposure to Wealth, Retirement, or Protection product lines.
* Knowledge of insurance ecosystem components including digital engagement, reporting, and analytics platforms.


**Key Competencies:\-**
**Customer Focus**
 Understands and anticipates customer needs; builds credibility in presales engagements.
   

  

**Solution Thinking**
 Able to connect prospect requirements to platform capability in a compelling way.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Works effectively across Sales, Practice, Product, and R\&D teams.
   

  

**Commercial Awareness**
 Understands the sales cycle and contributes actively to pipeline progression.
   

  

**Adaptability**
 Comfortable operating across multiple geographies, cultures, and prospect contexts.
   

  

**Attention to Detail**
 Delivers accurate, high\-quality presales content and documentation.
   

  

**About Sapiens International:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a leading global provider of software solutions for the insurance industry. Sapiens’ CoreSuite for Life \& Pension is a market\-leading policy administration platform deployed by insurers and pension providers across EMEA and APAC. The Insurance Practice drives the presales, proposition, and consultancy capability that supports Sapiens’ growth strategy in the L\&P sector.

* Provide technical sales support to help win new business.
* Track emissions exempt engines at customers ensuring compliance.
* Ability to capture, collate, engine diagnostic data using specialist tools (CANAPE/ DATALOGGER /EST/ET, etc.). Interpret results and draw conclusions and implement permanent solution.
* Evaluate \& Contribute to the design of new products and processes setup.
* Support and drive Dealer \& Distributor A\&I team capability improvement through Distributor Excellence review, responding to A\&I technical queries.

**What Skills You Will Have**

* Effective Communication: Clearly understand customers’ technical requirements, effectively feedback to product group and seek for solutions. Have the courage to manage tough conversations with customers.
* Problem Solving: Uses varying problem\-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate to resolve customer issues during A\&I phase.
* Project Management: Be able to manage project timeline, identify risks and develop risk mitigation plan, ensure project to be delivered to quality and in time.


**Required Qualifications**
* Competent in use of Standard business tools including, Excel, Power Point, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.
* Speak fluent English and excellent in reading, writing.
* Independently manage customers programs with minimum supervision.
* Well understanding of engine knowledge, performance, aftertreatment, NVH.
* More than 8 years of engine experience including application, design, performance, validation, etc.
* Bachelor degree or above in Engineering


**Desired Qualifications**
* Transmission and hydraulic knowledge.
* EP Knowledge, especially Data Center experience.
* External customer facing experience.


**Additional Information**
* Able to travel globally up to 50% of time to meet customer expectation and support sales.
* Willingness to visit customer site at short notice (less than 24 hrs) to investigate customer critical field issues.


 This position requires working onsite five days a week.

 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. **Job Description**
**What you’ll do:**
 The Advanced Services team provides exceptional outcomes and remarkable customer experience through "forward\-looking" technical services to optimize network reliability and performance for designated customers. We are passionate about enabling our customers towards a fast, risk\-free deployment of network services. We assist our customers to evaluate network for performance, scalability, and security and provides recommendations on network configurations and topologies to improve operational performance and identify/ mitigate major risk areas. Partnering on short\-term projects such as recommendation and implementation of new HPE Networking software and hardware features in the customer's network.

 Key responsibilities include the following, but are not limited to:
   

  

* The two main aspect of the role would be to represent HPE Networking customer service to the customer and as representative of the customer back to Juniper.

 The candidate is encouraged to have a deep understanding of core IP networking concepts (TCP/IP, QoS, VLAN, STP, IPSEC, NAT, IPv6\). Should possess reasonable expertise in Layer2, Layer3 protocols such as VRRP, OSPF, BGP, Multicast, MPLS VPN.
   

  

 Knowledge and experience of the newest technologies such as Segment Routing, Traffic engineering, DC switching, VxLAN, EVPN, SD\-WAN \& Wireless is a plus.
   

  

 Experience working in large enterprises, Network service providers have added advantage.
   

  

 ITIL Framework process knowledge will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Experience and desire to work on automation will be valuable in long run.
   

  

 Amiable communication, interpersonal and social skills will make a difference!
   

  

 HPE Networking product certifications (HPE Aruba Networking – switching, Campus access, Data Center, HPE Juniper – JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP/JNCIE) or industry equivalents are helpful.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
 We generally prefer candidates with bachelor’s degree in electrical/electronic Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. A Business degree such as MBA would be an advantage.
   

  

 9\+ years’ experience in designing, implementing, and solving technical problems of the state\-of\-the\-art Datacenter, IP/MPLS\- Networks. High exposure to network operations environment. Ability to operate independently, including management of priorities in unstructured environment with good communication skills.
